Title: Principal Technical Program Manager - FDE
Description:
**Overview**
In the Microsoft Frontier Company Engineering team, you won’t just build software; you’ll deliver real outcomes for some of the world’s most complex organizations.
  
  
We are a global team of world-class engineers who have been working in a Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) model for more than a decade, embedding directly within customer teams to solve their toughest challenges, side-by-side, and shipping production-ready solutions in days, not months.
  
  
As a Principal Technical Program Manager, you will embed with strategic customers to lead complex technical programs, owning the full customer journey from problem definition through delivery and driving measurable business outcomes. You’ll work in small, multidisciplinary crews alongside engineers, data scientists, and designers, operating with high autonomy to turn ambiguous problems into shipped solutions.
  
  
Our work is powered by AI, applying the mindset and tooling across the entire development lifecycle to move from idea to production in days while maintaining the highest standards of security, quality, and trust.
  
  
**This Role Offers The Opportunity To**

* Lead complex technical programs from problem definition through to delivered outcomes
* Drive decisions that directly influence business strategy and customer outcomes
* Collaborate with leading global organizations across industries
* Apply the latest advancements in AI and engineering workflows to deliver value at scale

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Embed with strategic customers to lead complex technical programs with high autonomy, aligning business needs with engineering solutions across AI, cloud, and data. Take ownership of the customer journey end-to-end, from problem definition through co-engineering delivery to measurable business outcomes.
* Apply AI assisted engineering practices as a daily operating mode: use AI tools across the full software development lifecycle to accelerate requirements-to-specs, generate high-quality engineering artifacts from customer context, and drive continuous flow of value from business need to production.
* Operate fluently in engineering tooling (e.g., VS Code, GitHub, AI agents) as primary work surfaces for planning, documentation, and technical program leadership. Validate AI-generated outputs with domain expertise to maintain quality at speed.
* Navigate ambiguity in customer environments with self-direction and high ownership. Make technical and program decisions with incomplete information, proactively identify opportunities and manage risks, providing data-driven recommendations to stakeholders.
* Champion and cultivate reusable solution patterns, open-source assets, and engineering playbooks that scale impact beyond individual engagements. Contribute to the broader engineering community through knowledge sharing and best practices.
* Partner with multi-disciplinary engineering teams (software engineers, data scientists, designers) to evaluate, design, and deliver AI-powered cloud solutions side-by-side with customer engineers. Give key stakeholders data-driven recommendations based on identified risks and tradeoffs.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree AND 10+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
* Or equivalent experience
* 5+ years of experience managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects.
* Experience partnering directly with customers or internal stakeholders to deliver solutions end-to-end.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. Title: Solution Delivery Manager
Location: Toronto, Ontario, Canada | Brampton, Ontario, Canada
Industry: Broadcast Media Production and Distribution, Book and Periodical Publishing, and Telecommunications
Description:
Our Technology team wakes up every day with one goal in mind - connecting Canadians to the people and things that matter most. Together, we are proud to support 30 million Canadians each month through managing a robust portfolio that champions leading-edge technology. We drive large-scale, complex, and high-visibility technology projects and programs that shape the future of technology in Canada and expand connectivity from coast to coast. If you are interested in being a part of this, consider applying for the following opportunity
  
  
**Who We're Looking For**
We are seeking a Solution Delivery Manager reporting to the Senior Manager, Residential Solution Delivery. In this role as Solution Delivery Manager, you will provide end-to-end leadership for the planning, solutioning, sequencing, and delivery of initiatives within an assigned workstream, squad, or program. You will establish trusted relationships with Product, Business, Architecture, Delivery, Security, Quality Assurance, and domain teams, translating product roadmaps and project requirements into aligned, executable delivery plans.
  
  
You will balance business outcomes, technical feasibility, risk, capacity, and release constraints. The role is accountable for driving clarity across scope, solution, estimates, dependencies, approvals, quality, and timelines while supporting teams through execution and issue resolution.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Stakeholder Partnership and Roadmap Alignment
  
  

* Build and sustain trusted relationships with Product and Business stakeholders, creating transparency on priorities, trade-offs, risks, and delivery outcomes.
* Develop a detailed understanding of the product roadmap for the assigned workstream, squad, or program and translate it into actionable delivery priorities.
* Partner closely with the Product Owner to shape the backlog, negotiate priorities, clarify acceptance outcomes, and maintain alignment to business value.
* Represent Solution Delivery in cross-functional discussions and ensure decisions, dependencies, and commitments are documented and communicated.

Requirements, Scope, and Solution Leadership
  
  

* Read and understand project requirements; challenge assumptions, identify gaps and dependencies, provide feedback, and sign off on the scope committed for delivery.
* Provide direction and guidance to the Business Analyst throughout project execution, including requirements clarification, dependency management, decision tracking, and issue resolution.
* Work closely with the Solution Architect to finalize the end-to-end solution, ensuring alignment across business requirements, architecture, integration, data, operations, security, and support considerations.
* Coordinate solution reviews with domain teams and Business stakeholders and obtain the required sign-offs before delivery proceeds.
* Work closely with the Cyber Security prime and the Business Systems Analyst to close security requirements, risks, assessments, and required approvals.

Integrated Planning and Delivery Management
  
  

* Work with domain leads and the Project Manager to sequence deliveries and formulate the Plan of Intent and Plan of Release in alignment with business goals, dependencies, team capacity, and release windows.
* Negotiate delivery timelines with domain teams, release dates, and other delivery commitments, while clearly identifying prerequisites and trade-offs.
* Obtain and consolidate estimates from all contributing teams; validate assumptions, dependencies, and resource needs to support an achievable integrated plan.
* Proactively identify delivery risks, scope gaps, resource constraints, and cross-team dependencies, and drive timely mitigation or escalation.
* Maintain clear delivery governance, decision records, status reporting, and accountability across the end-to-end lifecycle.

Facilitation, Decisions, and Governance
  
  

* Schedule and lead Joint Application Design (JAD) sessions with domain teams and relevant stakeholders.
* Ensure every JAD session and key delivery meeting has a clear agenda, required pre-work, appropriate decision-makers, and a specific outcome to be achieved.
* Drive timely decisions and sign-offs by surfacing options, impacts, risks, and recommendations in a concise and fact-based manner.
* Promote collaborative ways of working across Business and Technology teams, resolving conflict constructively and keeping teams focused on shared outcomes.

Quality Assurance and Delivery Support
  
  

* Ensure the QA Test Plan and Test Cases fully cover the approved project scope and end-to-end solution and align with expected business and technical results.
* Provide technical or process support during QA to help resolve defects, clarify intended behaviour, remove major blockers, and coordinate the appropriate domain expertise.
* Validate readiness for release by confirming scope completion, solution and security sign-offs, test evidence, operational readiness, dependencies, and outstanding risks.
* Support post-release reviews and continuous improvement by capturing lessons learned and strengthening delivery practices.

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of progressive experience in technology delivery, solution delivery, program delivery, systems implementation, or a related discipline, including demonstrated leadership across complex initiatives.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional delivery involving Product, Business, Architecture, Engineering, Security, Quality Assurance, Operations, vendors, and multiple technology domains.
* Strong understanding of the software delivery lifecycle, requirements practices, solution design, estimation, release planning, testing, defect management, and operational readiness.
* Demonstrated ability to understand technical and business requirements, evaluate end-to-end impacts, and make sound scope and delivery decisions.
* Experience facilitating JAD or solution-design sessions and driving groups toward clear, documented decisions and accountabilities.
* Strong negotiation and influencing skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, timelines, capacity constraints, and stakeholder expectations.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and executive communication skills; able to communicate complex topics clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail and a bias for action.
* Working knowledge of cybersecurity, privacy, risk, and governance requirements within enterprise technology delivery.
* Experience working in Agile, hybrid, and project-based delivery models; familiarity with backlog management and iterative planning practices.
* A collaborative leadership style that builds trust, protects sustainable team capacity, and creates accountability without compromising quality.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Stakeholders have a shared understanding of scope, solution, priorities, dependencies, timelines, and decisions.
* Delivery plans are integrated, realistic, and aligned to roadmap outcomes, team capacity, security obligations, and release constraints.
* JAD and governance forums produce clear decisions, owners, and next steps.
* Quality plans provide full coverage of the committed scope and defects are resolved through coordinated, timely support.
* Risks and blockers are identified early, managed transparently, and escalated with options and recommended actions.
* Teams deliver sustainable outcomes through clear roles, practical processes, and trusted cross-functional relationships.

**What’s in it for you?**
We believe in investing in our people and helping them reach their potential as valuable members of our team. As part of our team, you’ll have access to a wide range of incredible resources, growth opportunities, discounts, and perks, including
  
  

* Competitive salary & annual bonus
* Competitive & flexible health and dental benefits, pension plan, RRSP, TFSA, and Stock matching programs.
* Discounts Enjoy up to 50% off Rogers Services and Blue Jays Tickets, 25% off TSC items, and a 20% discount on all wireless accessories sold in Rogers stores.

Title: Assistant Service Delivery Manager, Aspire Lifestyles
Description:
**About The Role**
About Aspire Lifestyles
  
  
Aspire Lifestyles is a global provider of premium lifestyle management and concierge services, delivering personalised experiences to affluent and high-net-worth (HNW) customers worldwide. The company partners with leading banks, private banking institutions, credit card providers, insurance organisations, telecommunications companies, airlines, hospitality brands and premium retailers to provide bespoke services and exceptional customer experiences.
  
  
With a focus on service excellence, personalised solutions and operational efficiency, Aspire Lifestyles aims to exceed customer expectations through high-touch, seamless and reliable service delivery.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
The Assistant Service Delivery Manager will oversee the day-to-day management of service delivery operations, ensuring the effective fulfilment of customer requests and the delivery of exceptional concierge experiences. The role involves leading and developing the Lifestyle Concierge team, managing operational performance, maintaining client relationships and ensuring compliance with contractual service commitments, KPIs and SLAs.
  
  
The successful candidate will be responsible for driving a culture of service excellence, operational efficiency and continuous improvement while ensuring that affluent and high-net-worth customers receive personalised, high-quality and seamless service across all communication channels.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Service Delivery and Client Management**

* Manage daily service delivery across phone, email, chat, web and other channels, ensuring timely, accurate and personalised handling of customer requests.
* Understand client contracts and translate requirements into clear procedures, workflows and standards.
* Monitor SLAs, KPIs and operational performance, taking action to address gaps and improve service delivery cost-effectively.
* Build strong working relationships with client contacts and collaborate with Sales and Marketing on client retention, proposals, renewals and RFPs.
* Support and lead programme implementations and operational workflows as required.

**Quality And Customer Experience**

* Ensure consistent, high-quality service and compliance with client and Group standards, including Concierge Standards, PCI-DSS and ISO.
* Manage customer complaints and escalations promptly, ensuring effective resolution.
* Work with Partnerships to operationalise offers and benefits, and with QA and Training teams to conduct call and case reviews.
* Promote a resourceful, customer-focused culture that improves customer experience.

**People and Resource Management**

* Identify staffing and resource requirements and support recruitment.
* Lead, coach and motivate team members; set clear objectives, monitor performance and address development needs.
* Ensure employees understand and follow company policies, procedures and standards.
* Prepare monthly rosters that reflect business needs, coverage requirements and employee skill sets.
* Contribute to reward and recognition initiatives that encourage strong performance.

**Operational Risk, Audit and Compliance**

* Coordinate preparations for internal and external service delivery audits and maintain required standards.
* Ensure Business Continuity Plan (BCP) and Disaster Recovery (DR) procedures are followed during disruptions and escalate risks promptly.
* Promote compliance with company policies, values and occupational health and safety requirements.

**Financial and Business Performance**

* Improve processes and workflows to increase productivity and profitability.
* Manage staffing and operating costs, use resources effectively and support new programmes and services.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and customer value.

**Communication and Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Maintain regular communication so the team understands priorities and performance expectations.
* Present departmental performance updates to senior management and clients when required.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders, including Sales, Finance, Partnerships, QA, Training, HR, Recruitment and IT, to coordinate resources and meet business objectives.
* Participate in team meetings and cross-functional initiatives.

**Projects And Other Responsibilities**

* Support technology and transformation initiatives, including digital channels, CRM enhancements and change management.
* Undertake projects and other reasonable duties assigned by the Head of Aspire Lifestyles Operations.

**Required Experience, Skills And Qualification**
Required Experience & Qualifications
  
  

* Minimum 5 years of management-level experience.
* Experience in a management role within a lifestyle management or concierge environment.
* Experience managing an operational department with a minimum team size of 15 employees.
* Strong experience in call centre and customer service operations.
* Previous experience in client account management and managing service delivery commitments.
* Demonstrated business acumen and understanding of operational performance and cost management.
* Bachelor's degree.
* Proficiency in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and Visio.

**Desirable Experience**

* Experience in banking, private banking, hospitality, travel, airlines or other premium customer service industries.
* Exposure to managing high-net-worth and affluent customer segments.
* Experience supporting new client implementations, operational transitions and service improvement projects.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Leadership & People Management: Ability to lead, motivate, coach and develop teams while maintaining accountability and high performance.
* Customer Service Excellence: Strong customer-centric mindset with the ability to anticipate customer needs and deliver personalised service experiences.
* Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to manage challenging conversations and influence stakeholders.
* Problem-Solving & Decision-Making: Ability to assess complex situations, manage escalations and implement effective solutions.
* Drive for Results: Strong focus on achieving operational targets, improving service standards and delivering measurable results.
* Business Acumen: Understanding of operational costs, resource allocation, financial efficiency and opportunities for business improvement.
* Teamwork & Collaboration: Ability to build effective relationships and coordinate with internal, regional and global stakeholders.
* Coaching & Development: Ability to identify development needs, provide constructive feedback and encourage continuous learning.

**Additional Requirements & Conditions**
Language Requirements
  
  

* Excellent spoken and written English and Arabic.
* Additional languages will be considered an advantage.

Working Hours & Flexibility
  
  

* Flexibility to work varying shifts between 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM, including weekends, depending on operational requirements.
* Willingness to support business requirements and operational priorities as needed.

Travel Requirements
  
  

* Minimal travel, as required.

Title: Senior Engagement Manager, Professional Services
Description:
**Description**
Would you like a career that gives you opportunities to help customers and partners use cloud computing web services to do big new things faster , at lower cost? Do you want to be part of history and transform businesses through cloud computing adoption? Do you like to work on-site in a variety of business environments, leading teams through high impact projects that use the newest cloud infrastructure and platform technologies? Would you like a career path that enables you to progress with the rapid adoption of cloud computing?
  
  
At Amazon Web Services (AWS), we’re hiring a technical Engagement Manager to lead AWS consultants, partners and client teams. Engagement Managers manage and deliver AWS cloud products and services that enable our customers to realize their business objectives. These professional services engagements focus on the full platform of AWS customer solutions to help our customers and partners remove constraints and accelerate their journey to AWS.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As Engagement Manager you will manage projects independently and also deliver as part of larger teams.
  
  
You will own work streams end to end, starting by understanding the customer required outcomes, then leading the team through delivery, managing customer expectations, proactively handling risks and following an effective governance structure, in order to deliver solutions tied to the customer business objectives. You will communicate in an effective way with AWS team members and stakeholders, as well as with customer counterparts. Achieving customer satisfaction will be a relevant driver of your work.
  
  
As an Amazonian leader you will embrace and apply the Amazon Leadership Principles, proactively engaging other teams to learn and share, and participating actively in the recruitment and onboarding of future team members.
  
  
This is a customer facing role. You will be required to travel to client locations and deliver professional services when needed.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
AWS Professional Services engage in a wide variety of projects for customers and partners, providing collective AWS customer experience, best practices, and obsessing about strong success for the Customer. Our team collaborates across the entire AWS organization to bring access to product, service, and training teams, to deliver the right solutions and drive feature innovations for our customers across all industries. Engagement Managers help Customers make decisions to meet their technical and business objectives by providing best practices, proactively identifying and closing project gaps.
  
  
Amazon aims to be the most customer centric company on earth. Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers critical applications for hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world.

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

As an award-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture
  
  
With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, Africa, and APAC, we offer end-to-end expertise across eight core service areas: Digital Product Consulting, Digital Marketing Services, Data & AI, Strategy Consulting, Business Operations Modernization, Enterprise Applications, Cloud Engineering, and QA & Test Engineering.
  
  
From mobile apps and websites to voice UI, chatbots, AI, customer service, and in-store solutions, TELUS Digital enables seamless, trusted, and digitally powered experiences that meet customers wherever they are — all backed by the secure infrastructure and scale of our multi-billion-dollar parent company.
  
  
**Location & Flexibility**
This role will operate remotely in the
**United States**
or
**Canada**
OR be based out of one of our major North American office locations - Charlottesville, VA, Durham, NC, Columbus, OH, Boston, MA, Toronto, ON, or Vancouver, BC.
  
  
This role may involve travel of up to 25% to contact center and client locations.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking a
**Director, CX AI Delivery**
: a consultant and delivery expert who can turn complex contact center and AI programs into predictable, measurable outcomes. You will lead delivery across our CX AI portfolio, spanning Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) platforms, conversational and agentic AI, agent assist, and CX intelligence, and serve as a trusted advisor to client executives. You will manage a portfolio of client engagements (generally ~$15–20M in revenue), directly lead delivery, product, and engineering leaders, and step in to stabilize and recover programs when needed.
  
  
This is a delivery-first leadership role with an AI lens. You will bring the rigor of a seasoned delivery executive together with a working command of how AI is changing CX: from AI-driven routing and virtual agents to copilots, knowledge, and agentic automation. You will help clients adopt these capabilities responsibly, at scale, and in iterative releases that get value into production quickly. You will also help evaluate vendor and partner solutions and decide how and when new tools enter the ecosystem.
  
  
This position reports to the Managing Director, CX AI Delivery and typically manages 8–12 direct reports, including senior managers, managers, and principal-level delivery and technical leaders. The CSM will be the customer's advocate and single business-level point of contact for MSI products and systems such as Land Mobile Radio (LMR), Mission Critical Push-to-Talk (MCPTT) software, through to two-way radio solutions.
  
  
This position is for someone typically transitioning from a technical or business role to a Customer facing operations role, whose responsibilities will include ensuring that the contractual commitments are met or exceeded for the ongoing support contracts, within the countries and accounts assigned. The CSM is also responsible for driving services growth, by promoting support services, either as part of a new solution sale or as a standalone service.

***Operations***

* The Customer advocate, providing Customers with a single point of contact, to ensure service delivery and Service Level Agreements (SLA) compliance, including ensuring the correct level of quality escalations and timely resolutions are carried out
* Maintains product and software lifecycle plans including ensuring plans are provided/maintained from third party vendors
* Manages sub-contractors deliverables and adherence against Customer contractual commitments
* Executes the support service business plan, manage and report orders, revenue and costs, including identifying and implementing areas for improvement to ensure improved service margin, quality and best practice delivery
* Ensure a smooth transition from project implementation to warranty support and service delivery
* Manage the service contract renewal process for all assigned service agreements

***Business Development***

* Engage with the Customer to identify upsell opportunities within existing accounts, including software support solutions that are adapted to the Customers operational needs, capabilities and in turn mitigate the Customers operational risks
* Support the account managers when engaging with the Customers including; Customer meetings, financial and commercial negotiations, road shows, etc.
* Support the Pre-sales team with tender/proposal costs, risks & pricing, including supporting the Procurement team in sub-contractor scope, SLA’s, commercial negotiations and contract set-up

Basic Requirements
  
  
This position requires a high degree of customer engagement, sales support skills coupled with program planning, and technical knowledge of the various systems and subsystems that form the portfolio. Ideally, experience in working within the delivery or support of complex software solutions will be a benefit
  
  
**Personal Skills, Work And Management Style**

* Excellent communication skills in English (verbal, written and presentation). Also local languages will be appreciated (Arabic and/or French)
* Experience either within a Level 2 Technical Support Operations, Project Management, or Customer Support business environment including the ability to work with the Customer / End users at both Management and User levels
* Effective stakeholder management skills (internal and external), including the ability to articulate ideas clearly and concisely
* Capable of working through commercial issues and recommending courses of action with experience of problem solving and conflict resolution
* Self-motivated and the ability to effectively prioritise and multi-task, demonstrate flexibility and ownership within a fast-changing and ambiguous environment
* Focus on customers. Follow up until problems are resolved and act as a trusted resource who knows the customer's mission
* Knowledge of digital radio communications, LMR, IP networking, ITIL and computer systems, or holding a professional certification such as PMP or ITIL is a plus.

**Travel**
Travel will be no less than 25% of the time in the assigned region.
  
  
**Educational Background**

Experienced

Title: Director/Channel Management
Description:
**Job Description**
The Director – Channel Management is responsible for defining and driving the strategic roadmap for the telecom contact center, CIM applications, Knowledge Management, IVR, covering technology, processes, people capabilities and Operations. This role ensures that platforms and operating model are optimized to deliver superior customer experience, operational efficiency, and support the company’s digital and omnichannel strategy.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Strategy & Roadmap
* Develop and own the multi‑year contact center development strategy aligned with corporate objectives and customer experience goals.
* End-to-end management of the contact center transformation.
* Define the evolution of contact center capabilities (voice, chat, email, social, self‑service, bots, IVR, etc.) to support omnichannel customer journeys.
* Develop and own the roadmap of CIM and Knowledge management solution
* Definition and delivery of all programs to inject AI capabilities across the care channels.
* Identify and prioritize initiatives that improve customer satisfaction, reduce cost‑to‑serve, and enhance agent productivity.
* Technology & Platforms in Scope
* Lead the design, development, and operations of Care channel (ACD, IVR, CTI, CRM integration, WFM, WFO, quality monitoring, analytics).
* Oversee vendor selection, contract negotiations, and ongoing vendor management for care channels solutions.
* Ensure system architecture supports scalability, resilience, security, and integration with core telecom systems (billing, provisioning, CRM, digital channels).
* Drive automation and AI‑enabled capabilities such as intelligent routing, self‑service, knowledge management, humanized voice solutions to fulfil Business roadmap.
* Process & Experience Design
* Define and optimize end‑to‑end contact center processes, including call handling, escalation, complaint management, and service recovery.
* Collaborate with Customer Experience, Operations, and Digital teams to design customer journeys and service flows that minimize effort and improve first contact resolution.
* Establish and maintain standard operating procedures, playbooks, and best practices across all contact center sites.
* Supported the business in defining a comprehensive AI strategy for customer channels, focused on delivering superior customer experience. This included:

+ Aligning AI use cases across all interaction channels (e.g., apps, web, contact centre) with business objectives and CX KPIs
+ Designing AI enabled interaction models (chatbots, virtual assistants, intelligent routing, personalization) to enhance responsiveness, consistency, and service quality
+ Establishing governance, data, and performance frameworks to ensure AI solutions meet customer expectations, are scalable, and continuously improve

* Performance Management & Analytics
* Define and cascade KPIs and performance targets for all care channel management initiatives (e.g., NPS, CSAT, FCR, AHT, service level, productivity, automation rate), ensuring clear ownership and alignment with overall customer experience objectives.
* Establish robust, standardized reporting and analytics frameworks to continuously monitor performance across the care channels, identify trends, and highlight improvement opportunities.
* Leverage data‑driven insights to optimize routing strategies, refine staffing models, and prioritize technology and automation investments, thereby improving efficiency, service quality, and customer satisfaction.
* Stakeholder Management & Governance
* Serve as the primary point of contact for senior stakeholders on all matters related to care channel management (contact centre, digital care, field support, social care, and self service) and associated AI driven initiatives.

+ Lead cross functional governance forums to:
+ Align business requirements and customer experience objectives across all care channels
+ Prioritize channel transformation and AI projects based on impact, feasibility, and strategic value
+ Manage inter dependencies between processes, platforms, and teams to avoid duplication and ensure end to end consistency

* Coordinate closely with IT, Network, Marketing, Sales, and Finance to:

+ Ensure care channel strategies, capabilities, and AI solutions are fully aligned with enterprise roadmaps
+ Secure the necessary resources, budgets, and technology support for smooth implementation
+ Drive integrated execution across channels, enabling a seamless, consistent, and efficient customer care experience.

* Project & Change Management
* Oversee the portfolio of care channels projects from concept to deployment, ensuring delivery on time, within budget, and to quality standards.
* Implement structured project management and change management methodologies to ensure successful adoption by operations teams.
* Manage risk, issues, and change requests, ensuring minimal disruption to live operations.
* People Leadership
* Lead and develop a high‑performing team of managers, architects, business analysts, and project managers focused on contact center development.
* Define team structure, roles, and competencies required to support the roadmap.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and collaboration across internal teams and external partners.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or related field; Master’s degree is preferred.
* 12–15+ years of experience in care channels, customer experience, or operations within telecom or similar large‑scale service industries.
* Proven track record in leading large, complex contact center transformation or development programs.
* Strong understanding of contact center technologies (e.g., Genesys, Avaya, Cisco, NICE, Verint, WFM tools, CRM platforms, Knowledge management).
* Experience in managing vendors, contracts, and budgets for technology and services.

The
**Senior Manager, Customer Service Operations**
is responsible for leading the frontline service organization while helping shape how Customer Service evolves as goeasy grows. This role combines strong people leadership and operational discipline with a focus on simplifying how work gets done, using data and technology more effectively, and building a service organization that can scale. The Senior Manager will use customer feedback, operational data, and frontline insights to identify opportunities, solve recurring problems, and partner across the organization to improve workflows, enable smarter technology and automation, and create better experiences for both customers and employees.
  
  
Lead exceptional customer experiences. Build smarter ways of working. Shape a service organization that is responsive, scalable, and easier for customers and employees to navigate.
  
  
**What will you be doing?**

* Lead and evolve day-to-day Customer Service operations, ensuring customer interactions are handled efficiently, accurately, professionally, and within established service levels, while continuously looking for ways to make the experience simpler and more effective.
* Establish clear performance expectations and operating routines that drive customer focus, productivity, responsiveness, quality, and accountability, while challenging routines that create unnecessary complexity or manual work.
* Own and monitor key operational KPIs, including service levels, response times, adherence, productivity, volumes, customer outcomes, and other measures that demonstrate the health and effectiveness of the operation.
* Lead the management and resolution of complex customer issues and escalations, ensuring appropriate ownership, timely resolution, thoughtful communication, and a strong focus on customer outcomes.
* Act as a customer advocate by identifying trends in customer feedback, dissatisfaction, and escalations and ensuring the voice of the customer is reflected in operational priorities and decisions.
* Analyze customer and operational data to identify recurring issues, performance gaps, and opportunities to simplify the experience, improve decision making, and reduce avoidable customer and employee effort.
* Partner with Operational Experience & Process Design, Technology, Product, Analytics, and other teams to translate frontline pain points into practical technology, automation, workflow, and experience improvements.
* Identify opportunities to leverage technology, automation, self-service, and data to improve the customer experience, reduce manual effort, and enable frontline teams to focus on higher-value customer interactions.
* Ensure new tools, technologies, processes, initiatives, and ways of working are effectively implemented within Customer Service, with strong frontline readiness, adoption, accountability, and performance monitoring.
* Establish strong performance management and coaching routines that develop leaders and frontline associates, strengthen capability, address performance gaps, and create a culture of ownership and continuous learning.
* Lead workforce and capacity management in partnership with relevant teams, balancing customer demand, staffing, productivity, occupancy, service levels, and employee experience.
* Ensure appropriate operational controls, policies, procedures, and governance are followed, identifying risks and control gaps and taking action to protect customers and the business.
* Build strong relationships across Operations, Risk, Compliance, Product, Analytics, and Technology to solve customer problems and improve how work flows across the organization.
* Continuously challenge how Customer Service operates, identifying opportunities to simplify work, remove customer and employee friction, automate manual activity, and build a more efficient and scalable service organization.
* Build, lead, and develop a high-performing service leadership team, creating a culture of customer obsession, accountability, curiosity, coaching, problem solving, and continuous improvement.

**What experience do you have?**

* 5–10 years of experience in customer service, customer experience, contact centre operations, business transformation, technology-enabled operations, financial services, lending, or a related environment.
* Demonstrated experience leading people leaders and frontline teams, with a strong track record of coaching, developing talent, and building high-performing teams.
* Strong understanding of customer service and contact centre operations, including service levels, productivity, workforce management, customer experience, and performance management, combined with experience redesigning workflows, improving processes, and modernizing how service organizations operate.
* Experience partnering with Technology, Product, Analytics, or similar teams to translate business and customer problems into technology, automation, workflow, or digital solutions.
* Experience implementing or improving customer service technologies, automation, self-service, workflow tools, or other technology-enabled solutions is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex customer issues and escalations with sound judgment, empathy, and a strong focus on customer outcomes.
* Strong communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to work effectively with senior leaders and cross-functional partners.
* Experience in financial services, lending, customer operations, or a regulated environment is an asset, with an understanding of regulatory, risk, and customer protection requirements.
* Post-secondary education in Business, Operations, Customer Experience, Technology, or a related field is preferred.

**Meet the Team**
Splunk is the heart of enterprise resilience, and our team is the pulse of that mission. We are a global, inclusive group of authentic problem-solvers who thrive under pressure and bring our whole selves to work. By operating as a unified global unit that values transparency, mutual respect, and continuous learning, we turn technical chaos into orderly recovery and build stronger, more resilient infrastructure for the future.
  
  
**Your Impact**
As a Major Incident Manager, you are the calm in the storm and the conductor of the orchestra when high-priority incidents hit. Your role is to take control, mobilize the right engineering experts, and translate complex technical situations into a clear, actionable plan. You won't just be managing tickets; you’ll be the bridge between technical diagnosis and executive visibility, ensuring that customer-impacting issues are resolved with precision and speed. We look for candidates who have a blend of technical operations experience and the emotional intelligence to navigate high-pressure situations. You should be comfortable leading global teams and be ready to jump into complex distributed systems environments.
  
  

* Lead high-priority incidents from intake through recovery, acting as the primary point of command.
* Orchestrate cross-functional engineering teams, removing coordination blockers and keeping the response focused.
* Distill complex technical conditions into clear, factual updates for executive stakeholders and customers.
* Maintain a "single source of truth" using tools like Incident.io, Jira, and Slack to ensure transparency.
* Drive post-incident reviews to capture lessons learned, turning yesterday’s failures into tomorrow’s optimizations.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 5+ years of professional experience
* 3+ years of Major Incident Management, SRE, Cloud Operations, or technical program management.
* Experience supporting SaaS solutions, hands-on technical experience in the engineering realm or experience working through an incident management ticketing system supporting technology products.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience using Splunk or similar enterprise observability and security platforms
* Proven experience leading complex, customer-impacting incidents involving multiple technical teams.
* Strong understanding of SaaS, cloud environments, distributed systems, and observability signals.
* Demonstrated ability to influence without authority, manage conflict, and prioritize under pressure.
* ITIL Foundations certification or equivalent formal training in incident management.
* Experience building or maturing incident management standards, scorecards, or metrics.
* History of facilitating incident simulations, "game days," or coaching Incident Commanders.
* Background in developing documentation, runbooks, or governance models for global teams.

**Work Pattern**
This role participates in a global coverage model operating 24 hours a day, seven days a week, and requires flexibility for four 10-hour shifts per week, regional handoffs, nights, weekends, holidays, and occasional extended incident response. On-call participation will be required based on coverage and incident needs. The role is expected to maintain sustainable response practices and use documented handoffs rather than relying on informal after-hours coverage.

We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

Title: Customer Support Manager - State of Arizona
Description:
**Company Overview**
At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.
  
  
**Department Overview**
At Motorola Solutions, we empower people to be at their best in the moments that matter. From helping firefighters see through smoke to giving police officers eyes around street corners, our work is meaningful, impactful, and cutting-edge. As a global leader in professional mobile communications, we leverage a rich heritage of technological innovation and an extensive worldwide presence to design and deliver mission-critical digital communication systems for government and public safety organizations around the globe.
  
  
**Job Description**
The primary responsibility of the Customer Support Manager (CSM) is to effectively and efficiently manage the Lifecycle Service (LCS) business for assigned customer contracts, ensuring maximum customer satisfaction among Motorola Solutions Public Safety customers in the state of Arizona. The LCS business encompasses revenue forecasting, proposing new services, managing contract renewals, and building strong relationships with both customers and subcontractors.
  
  
Ensuring customer satisfaction requires seamless delivery and execution of all service contracts. Title: IT Project Manager
Description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**IT Project Manager – ERP & E-Invoicing Implementation**

**Job Title:** IT Project Manager  
**Department:** Information Technology / Project Management  
**Location:** UAE  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 5–8 Years (preferred)  
**Reporting To:** Head of IT / Director / Management

**1. Job Purpose**

We are looking for a proactive, organized, and results-oriented IT Project Manager to plan, coordinate, execute, and deliver IT implementation projects, particularly in the areas of ERP systems, e-invoicing, ERP add-on solutions, business process automation, and other technology-driven initiatives.

The candidate will be responsible for managing projects from initiation through completion, acting as the primary coordination point between clients, management, functional consultants, technical teams, and external vendors.

The ideal candidate should possess excellent project management, client relationship management, communication, scheduling, and reporting skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and ensure delivery within agreed timelines, budgets, and quality standards.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Project Planning & Execution**

* Develop comprehensive project plans, implementation schedules, milestones, and delivery timelines.
* Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, resource requirements, and responsibilities.
* Coordinate and manage end-to-end implementation projects, including ERP implementations, e-invoicing solutions, ERP add-ons, and system integrations.
* Monitor project progress against agreed timelines and ensure timely completion of milestones.
* Identify potential project risks, dependencies, bottlenecks, and delays and implement corrective actions.
* Ensure appropriate allocation and utilization of project resources.
* Manage multiple client projects simultaneously.

**B. Client Coordination & Relationship Management**

* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned clients throughout the project lifecycle.
* Conduct project kick-off meetings and coordinate discussions with client stakeholders.
* Understand client requirements and coordinate with functional and technical teams to ensure proper execution.
* Schedule client meetings, workshops, review sessions, and follow-up discussions.
* Maintain regular communication with clients regarding project progress, pending activities, issues, and deliverables.
* Follow up with clients for data, documents, approvals, access credentials, and other implementation requirements.
* Manage client expectations and ensure a positive project delivery experience.

**C. ERP Implementation & System Integration**

* Coordinate ERP implementation, customization, enhancement, and integration projects.
* Work closely with functional consultants, developers, database administrators, and third-party vendors.
* Monitor requirement gathering, solution design, configuration, development, testing, UAT, and deployment activities.
* Coordinate data migration, system integration, user training, and post-implementation support.
* Ensure proper documentation of business requirements, functional specifications, testing results, and project sign-offs.

**D. Meetings, Scheduling & Follow-ups**

* Organize and schedule internal and external project meetings.
* Prepare meeting agendas and circulate them to relevant stakeholders.
* Record meeting minutes (MoM), action points, responsibilities, and target completion dates.
* Follow up with respective team members and clients to ensure closure of pending action items.
* Maintain project calendars and ensure that all important milestones and meetings are scheduled in advance.

**E. Project Monitoring & Reporting**

* Prepare and circulate weekly and monthly project progress reports to management and clients.
* Maintain project trackers covering milestones, deliverables, pending tasks, dependencies, and completion status.
* Monitor project timelines and highlight delays or deviations.
* Prepare management dashboards highlighting project status, risks, issues, and resource utilization.
* Escalate critical issues and seek management intervention wherever necessary.
* Ensure timely submission and approval of project deliverables.

**F. Documentation & Quality Management**

* Maintain project documentation, including:
* Project Charter and Project Plan.
* Requirement Gathering Documents.
* Meeting Minutes and Action Trackers.
* Project Milestone and Progress Reports.
* Risk and Issue Registers.
* Testing and UAT Sign-off Documents.
* Go-Live and Project Closure Reports.
* Ensure proper documentation and handover of completed projects to support teams.
* Coordinate hypercare and post-go-live support activities.

**G. UAE E-Invoicing Project Management – (preferable)**

* Coordinate e-invoicing and similar implementation projects.
* Understand the overall e-invoicing framework, Peppol architecture, PINT AE specifications, and relevant FTA/MoF requirements.
* Coordinate with clients to understand their existing invoicing processes, ERP systems, and business requirements.
* Plan and monitor ERP integration, e-invoice configuration, testing, validation, and go-live activities.
* Coordinate with technical teams, ERP consultants, and Accredited Service Providers (ASPs), where applicable.
* Track implementation issues, functional gaps, testing results, and resolution timelines.
* Ensure that project deliverables are completed in accordance with agreed regulatory and implementation requirements.

**3. Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 5–8 years of experience in IT project management, ERP implementation, or IT consulting.
* Experience managing multiple client-facing implementation projects.
* Knowledge of ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or other business management solutions.
* Exposure to e-invoicing implementation, system integration, or digital transformation projects will be an advantage.
* Knowledge of UAE VAT and the UAE e-invoicing framework will be an added advantage.
* PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, or other project management certifications will be preferred.

**4. Required Skills & Competencies**

* Excellent project planning and execution skills.
* Strong client coordination and stakeholder management abilities.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Strong organizational, scheduling, and follow-up capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities.
* Good problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making skills.
* Strong reporting and presentation skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and MS Project or equivalent project management tools.
* Familiarity with Jira, Trello, Monday.com, Asana, or similar project tracking tools.
* Ability to work independently and coordinate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and commitment to project deadlines.

**5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The candidate's performance will be evaluated based on:

* **Project Delivery:** Percentage of projects completed within agreed timelines.
* **Milestone Achievement:** Timely completion of project milestones and deliverables.
* **Client Satisfaction:** Client feedback and satisfaction levels.
* **Project Reporting:** Timely submission of project progress reports and status updates.
* **Issue Resolution:** Effective tracking and closure of project issues and action items.
* **Meeting Management:** Effective scheduling, documentation, and follow-up of meetings.
* **Project Documentation:** Completeness and accuracy of project documentation.
* **Resource Coordination:** Effective coordination and utilization of internal and external resources.
* **Go-Live Management:** Successful coordination of testing, deployment, and go-live activities.

**6. Preferred Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate should be a hands-on project manager who can independently manage day-to-day project activities without requiring continuous supervision.

The candidate must be comfortable interacting with senior client management, coordinating with technical and functional teams, managing implementation schedules, preparing progress reports, and ensuring that all stakeholders remain aligned with project objectives.

Experience in an IT consulting or software implementation company, particularly in ERP and e-invoicing projects, will be highly preferred.

Pay: AED5,900.00 - AED25,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Title: Regional Risk Manager - TRM and Cyber GRC
Description:
6 Nov 2026

Dubai, AE, PO Box 506

**1. Purpose of the role**
--------------------------

This role sits across both the EMEA Technology Risk Management group and the EMEA Cyber Governance, Risk and Control group. It is a first line regional role responsible for broad technology and cyber risk and control activity across the Middle East, while contributing to the wider EMEA operating model.

The role supports the identification, assessment, ownership, treatment and monitoring of technology and cyber risks. It also supports the design, implementation, operation, testing, evidence and remediation of controls. Reporting and management information are important enabling activities, but they are not the primary focus of the role.

The post holder will work as part of the established regional team and in close partnership with existing Technology Risk Management, Cyber GRC, Information Security and Technology colleagues. The role is intended to complement existing individuals in the region by adding capacity, coordination and specialist risk and control capability. It does not create parallel ownership or replace established accountabilities. The role reports locally to the Head of IT for the Middle East and maintains functional alignment with both the EMEA Technology Risk Management and EMEA Cyber GRC teams in London.

**2. Background**
-----------------

* Operates within the first line Technology and Cyber organisation, reporting locally to the Head of IT for Dubai, with functional alignment to the EMEA Technology Risk Management and EMEA Cyber GRC teams in London.
* Provides a clear Middle East regional presence from Dubai and connects regional requirements, risks and control matters into the wider EMEA framework.
* Supports a strong, consistent and transparent technology and cyber risk and control environment aligned to internal frameworks, risk appetite and applicable regulatory expectations.
* Works with regional and global stakeholders to improve consistency while preserving local ownership, expertise and decision rights.

**3. Principal accountabilities and responsibilities**
------------------------------------------------------

**Unless specifically stated otherwise, each responsibility below applies across both technology and cyber risk, controls, governance and assurance.**

**First line technology and cyber risk management**
---------------------------------------------------

* Support the identification, assessment, ownership, treatment, acceptance, monitoring and evidence based closure of technology and cyber risks and issues across EMEA.
* Maintain an integrated, decision ready view of material risks, control gaps, issues, exceptions, actions, decisions, milestones, dependencies and remediation activity, linked to business impact, risk appetite and regulatory expectations.
* Embed practical risk management within day to day Technology and Cyber activities, programmes, projects, services and material change initiatives.
* Ensure risks and issues are clearly articulated, consistently assessed, linked to relevant work and assigned to accountable owners.
* Provide constructive first line challenge on risk assessments, treatment plans, evidence and closure proposals without assuming ownership held by service or control owners.

**Technology and cyber risk and control management**
----------------------------------------------------

* Support the design, implementation, operation, testing, evidencing, validation and improvement of proportionate technology and cyber controls.
* Help define clear control objectives, ownership, frequency, evidence requirements, performance measures, quality gates and escalation triggers.
* Identify recurring weaknesses and thematic issues, and support sustainable improvements to control design, operation and evidence quality.
* Help owners address overdue or Red and Amber items through practical recovery plans with clear owners, dates, blockers, escalation routes and closure criteria.

**Regulatory compliance and assurance**
---------------------------------------

* Coordinate first line responses to regulatory requirements, including DORA, EBA guidance, relevant Middle East expectations and entity or Head Office requests.
* Translate regulatory requirements into practical controls, processes, evidence and accountable actions.
* Maintain a controlled record of commitments, owners, inputs, dates, evidence, blockers, dependencies and escalation status.
* Maintain traceability between obligations, policies, standards, controls, risks, evidence, findings and remediation.
* Coordinate input from subject matter experts and control owners so submissions are accurate, complete, consistent, reviewed and evidence based while preserving their accountability.

**Technology and cyber policy and standards governance**
--------------------------------------------------------

* Support policy owners with the review, update, approval and governance of technology and cyber policies and standards, maintaining alignment with regulation, internal frameworks and control obligations.
* Coordinate owners, reviewers and approvers through the policy lifecycle and annual approval cycle.
* Manage policy exceptions through documented justification, risk assessment, compensating controls, approval and review dates.
* Support technology and cyber policy improvement activity, including ECB related requirements, cyber skills framework operationalisation and associated process governance.

**Technology and cyber metrics, KRIs and management information**
-----------------------------------------------------------------

* Coordinate the monthly technology and cyber metrics cycle with accountable data and metric owners.
* Help owners define and review KRIs, KCIs and KPIs, including thresholds, data sources, ownership and data quality controls.
* Coordinate action where performance is outside tolerance or evidence is incomplete.
* Provide clear analysis of trends, service health, control effectiveness, risks, issues, remediation progress and regulatory commitments.
* Support controlled automation of reporting processes using approved tooling, with clear ownership, testing, auditability and traceability.

**Technology and cyber committee and executive reporting**
----------------------------------------------------------

* Support and coordinate technology and cyber reporting for the Security and Technology Risk Committee and provide reviewed Technology Risk Management and Cyber GRC input to other executive, entity and Head Office forums.
* Prepare concise, accurate papers covering material risks, controls, actions, service health and decisions.
* Maintain consistency and traceability across submissions while respecting forum ownership and approval routes.
* Coordinate contributors to meet deadlines, resolve data or evidence gaps and maintain clear records of decisions and actions.

**Technology and cyber audit and remediation management**
---------------------------------------------------------

* Act as a senior first line coordination contact for technology and cyber Internal and External Audit activity, supporting accountable owners and clarifying ownership where responsibility is shared or unclear.
* Coordinate audit engagement, document requests, evidence, stakeholder responses, management responses and governance updates.
* Support agreement of practical remediation actions with accountable owners, milestones, due dates, closure criteria and validation requirements.
* Track findings and actions through to evidence based closure, reporting progress and escalating overdue or off track items through agreed routes.
* Identify recurring themes and use audit outcomes to improve controls, evidence quality and the wider risk and control environment.

**Technology and cyber stakeholder leadership and engagement**
--------------------------------------------------------------

* Act as a key supporting Technology Risk Management and Cyber GRC contact across EMEA, building effective relationships across Cyber Security, Technology, Risk, Compliance, Legal and Audit.
* Influence senior and distributed stakeholders to resolve control weaknesses, evidence gaps, overdue remediation and risks outside tolerance while preserving local accountability.
* Explain complex cyber, regulatory and control matters in clear business language.
* Coordinate regional and global stakeholders and provide constructive challenge through pragmatic, delivery focused working relationships.

**First line technology and cyber governance, operating model and continuous improvement**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* Support and improve the first line Technology Risk Management and Cyber GRC frameworks, operating model, service structure and service catalogue, with clear scope, ownership, decision rights, service levels, measures and evidence requirements.
* Apply clear RACI responsibilities, governance routes, escalation paths, review routes and approval standards across business as usual services, projects, commitments, audit actions and reporting outputs.
* Support governance forums with accurate papers, decisions, actions and risk insight, and partner with business, technology and control teams to embed ownership and remediation discipline.
* Maintain a reliable view of Run and Build activity linked to risks, actions, decisions and deliverables.
* Promote practical improvements to portfolio, workflow, reporting and evidence processes based on performance, risk, control, audit and stakeholder feedback.
  

The role may include the areas of responsibility described above as directed by line management, together with other tasks that may reasonably be required to support business, operational and regulatory needs.

**4. Role scope and scale**
---------------------------

* A shared regional role across the EMEA Technology Risk Management and EMEA Cyber GRC groups, with a focus on the Middle East.
* Broad first line responsibility across technology risk, cyber risk, controls, governance, regulatory activity, audit, issues and remediation.
* Works across infrastructure, applications, cloud, data, resilience, change, third parties and cyber security services.
* Has no direct reports and relies on collaboration, influence and clear coordination across regional, EMEA and global stakeholders.
* Adds capability and regional capacity while respecting the roles, expertise and ownership of existing team members.

**5. Knowledge, skills and experience**
---------------------------------------

* Strong experience in Technology Risk Management, Cyber GRC, technology risk, cyber risk, controls or assurance within a regulated environment.
* Practical experience operating in a first line role with responsibility for managing risks and supporting the design, operation and remediation of controls.
* Strong understanding of first line and second line responsibilities within an enterprise risk management framework.
* Experience assessing risks and controls across technology services, infrastructure, applications, cloud, data, resilience, change and third party arrangements.
* Experience coordinating regulatory, audit, issue and remediation activity, with strong evidence and records discipline.
* Knowledge of applicable regulatory expectations and recognised frameworks such as DORA, EBA guidance, NIST, ISO 27001 and COBIT.
* Experience working across regional and global teams and the judgement to add value alongside established colleagues without duplicating ownership.
* Strong stakeholder management, written communication, organisation and prioritisation skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority.

**6. Key challenges**
---------------------

* Maintaining a clear and complementary role across two EMEA groups while providing coherent regional support across the Middle East.
* Embedding consistent risk and control practices across diverse entities, services, stakeholders and regulatory environments.
* Influencing distributed risk and control owners to address control weaknesses, evidence gaps and overdue remediation.
* Balancing concurrent risk, regulatory, audit, governance and remediation priorities without weakening day to day delivery.
* Translating evolving requirements and risk themes into practical, sustainable controls and accountable actions.

**7. What we offer**
