**Skills**

* Enterprise & Systems Thinking: Connects business priorities, technology dependencies, capacity and delivery constraints across the end-to-end ecosystem, making decisions that optimise overall product delivery rather than individual teams or initiatives
* Servant Leadership & Empowerment: Creates clarity and accountability while empowering teams to own execution, removing systemic barriers and enabling autonomous squads to perform effectively
* Influence & Stakeholder Alignment: Builds alignment across Product, Architecture, Engineering and Delivery, constructively challenging assumptions, facilitating trade-offs and driving timely decisions without relying on hierarchical authority
* Transformation & Coaching Leadership: Leads change by introducing proven product-led delivery practices, coaching teams and leaders, challenging established ways of working and building sustainable organisational delivery capability.

Title: Partnership Program Manager
Industry: Venture Capital and Private Equity Principals
Description:
Location: Flexible. This role can be based in most Antler markets, with a preference for the UAE or Singapore. Remote considered for exceptional candidates in a compatible time zone.
  
  
Reports to: Partner & Head of Global Partnerships
  
  
**About Antler**
Antler is where founders come to go further, faster.
  
  
Antler is the world's most active early-stage investor, backing exceptional people at the very start of their journey and supporting them from inception to scale. Across 27 cities worldwide, including New York, San Francisco, London, Berlin, Bangalore, Singapore, Seoul and Sydney, the firm helps founders remove the barriers to building by connecting them with world-class peers, validating business models, and providing initial capital.
  
  
To date Antler has backed more than 2,000 startups globally supported by a structured investment process and a global network of advisors and domain experts.
  
  
The role
  
  
We are looking for a Partnership Program Manager to own cross-functional alignment and delivery across our expanding group of partners, spanning AI and technology, banking, service providers, strategic investors, economic development groups and community programs. Our most recent partnership runs across every market we operate in, and this role owns its delivery first.
  
  
This is a program management role first, business development and partnership expansion come second. Each partnership carries a defined annual work plan: a schedule of founder-facing sessions, masterclasses, co-building workshops and ecosystem events across markets, structured feedback from our founder community, and quarterly reporting to both sides. Delivery is measured against a scorecard and milestones, and commercial terms are tied to it. You will own those scorecards end to end.
  
  
You will sit in the Partnerships team and work across Platform, Portfolio, Marketing, Tech, and the regional teams in every market where our partnerships run. Externally you are the day-to-day counterpart to partner engagement and marketing leads.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own the annual delivery plan for each partnership across all markets, holding the schedule, owners and status for every committed deliverable
* Run quarterly partner reviews: prepare the data, present performance against the scorecard, and agree actions
* Maintain a single source of truth for delivery, participation and adoption metrics across the partnership portfolio
* Coordinate the founder-facing programming calendar with regional teams, and drive attendance against committed minimums where a market is tracking behind
* Own the structured feedback and product evaluation workstreams, including partner surveys and the quality of what is submitted
* Coordinate co-marketing with the Marketing team, including partnership content, event branding, newsletter placement and announcement moments

**Requirements**

* 4 or more years in partnership delivery, program management, alliance management, customer success or a comparable operating role, ideally with a large enterprise counterparty
* Demonstrated ownership of a multi-workstream program with external reporting obligations and fixed deadlines
* Strong operating discipline: you build the tracker, you chase the owners, and you know the status without having to ask
* Comfortable holding internal stakeholders to their commitments, across time zones and without direct authority
* Credible with partners' senior stakeholders, including when the numbers are not flattering
* Data-literate and a clear writer: able to build and defend a reporting pack, and to make complex delivery legible to people who were not in the room

**Not Essential, But Nice To Have**

* Experience with or inside a major technology platform, cloud provider or enterprise partner program
* Experience in venture capital, accelerators or startup ecosystem organisations
* Experience as a founder or early operator at a venture-backed company
* Working proficiency in a second language relevant to our priority markets

What Antler offers
  
  
The Opportunity To Be Part Of a Growing Global Business, See The Impact Of Your Work Day To Day, And Join Our Mission To Back The World's Most Driven Founders From Day One. Along With That, You Will
  
  

* Shape the direction of Antler locally and across geographies, on a platform that builds and invests in hundreds of companies every year
* Grow your network and understanding of the startup, VC and innovation space, supported by a personal L&D budget
* Flexible working hours, 4 weeks remote working per year, birthday days off and Summer Hours
* A competitive salary and incentives

Title: Service Project Manager - Compression

Title: Data Privacy & Security – Senior Manager

At Capco, we are looking for an experienced **Data Privacy & Security – Senior Manager** to support enterprise-wide data privacy, protection and security transformation programmes for our financial services clients in Saudi Arabia. You will play a key role in designing, implementing and operationalising data privacy and protection capabilities aligned with Saudi Arabia's Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL), National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) frameworks and applicable regulatory requirements. Working closely with Data Privacy, Compliance, Information Security, IT and business stakeholders, you will translate complex regulatory and operational requirements into practical controls, governance frameworks, technology-enabled processes and sustainable operating models. This is an opportunity to lead high-impact advisory and technology transformation engagements, helping financial institutions strengthen their privacy capabilities, manage regulatory obligations and build greater confidence in how they protect and manage data.

**What You'll Do**

* **Lead privacy and security transformation:** Assess enterprise privacy maturity, define data privacy and governance strategies, develop target operating models, capability frameworks and transformation roadmaps aligned with Saudi PDPL, NCA and wider regulatory requirements.
* **Deliver privacy technology solutions:** Lead the implementation and integration of privacy management platforms such as OneTrust, BigID and Securiti, overseeing data discovery, classification, data mapping, consent management, data subject access requests (DSARs), privacy impact assessments and third-party risk workflows.
* **Embed privacy into business operations:** Design and operationalise privacy policies, controls, procedures and workflows covering data subject rights, incident management, data lifecycle management and regulatory compliance, while integrating privacy and security requirements into business processes and digital transformation initiatives.
* **Drive client engagement and delivery excellence:** Collaborate with senior stakeholders, technology teams and platform vendors to manage solution design, integration, testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), deployment and post-go-live stabilisation, while facilitating workshops and translating complex requirements into actionable recommendations.
* **Build sustainable privacy capabilities:** Advise clients on emerging privacy and security challenges associated with AI, cloud adoption and digital transformation, developing practical playbooks, operating procedures, training materials and knowledge-transfer activities that strengthen long-term organisational capabilities.

**What We're Looking For**

* **Extensive privacy and security consulting experience:** At least 10 years of relevant experience across data privacy, data protection, information security or data governance, including delivery of complex advisory, technology implementation and transformation engagements.
* **Strong regulatory and governance expertise:** In-depth understanding of Saudi PDPL, NCA frameworks and applicable regional privacy and cybersecurity requirements, with experience translating regulatory obligations into practical governance models, controls and operational processes.
* **Privacy technology implementation experience:** Experience working with platforms such as OneTrust, BigID, Securiti or equivalent, supported by knowledge of data discovery, classification, consent management, DSARs, privacy assessments and data lifecycle management.
* **Client leadership and programme delivery:** Experience advising senior stakeholders, managing multidisciplinary teams, overseeing complex engagements and contributing to business development, solution shaping and client proposals.
* **Communication and stakeholder engagement:** Ability to communicate complex regulatory and technical concepts clearly, build effective client relationships, facilitate workshops and deliver practical recommendations that support measurable business outcomes.

**Bonus Points For**

* Experience working with financial institutions in Saudi Arabia or the wider GCC region.
* Experience leading end-to-end implementations of enterprise privacy management platforms, including integration, testing and operational adoption.
* Knowledge of Saudi regulatory frameworks, including NCA Essential Cybersecurity Controls (ECC), National Data Management Office (NDMO) standards and Saudi Central Bank (SAMA) requirements.
* Relevant professional certifications such as CIPP/E, CIPM, CISM, CDPSE, CISSP or equivalent.
* Experience supporting business development, shaping consulting proposals and developing long-term client relationships within regulated industries.

**Why Join Capco**

* Deliver high-impact technology solutions for Tier 1 financial institutions.
* Work in a collaborative, flat, and entrepreneurial consulting culture.
* Access continuous learning, training, and industry certifications.
* Be part of a team shaping the future of digital financial services.
* Help shape the future of digital transformation across FS & Energy.

We offer a competitive, people-first benefits package designed to support every aspect of your life.

**Inclusion at Capco**

We're committed to making our recruitment process accessible and straightforward for everyone. If you need any adjustments at any stage, just let us know – we'll be happy to help. We value each person's unique perspective and contribution. At Capco, we believe that being yourself is your greatest strength. Our #BeYourselfAtWork culture encourages individuality and collaboration – a mindset that shapes how we work with clients and each other every day.

Title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Engineering Programs
Description:
The role

You'll own the health of how Product Development works at Cosmo. That means designing our operating rhythm, running cross-layer programs from hardware through software, leading the change it takes for new practices to stick, and giving leadership a clear, trusted read on delivery and release health. You'll partner closely with a Release Manager, who runs the release system day to day.

**This job is fully remote work on a weekly basis. There are 1-2 day in-person meet-ups with the team approximately every 2 months. We want someone located in the Toronto area, but is willing to work remotely.**

What you'll do

* Own engineering program health across hardware, firmware, app and cloud, and report out on delivery and release health to leadership.
* Build and own the timelines for software and firmware deliverables on new product introductions (NPI), mapping them to hardware milestones and manufacturing builds so nothing gates a launch.
* Design, document and roll out our agile operating rhythm: sprint planning, standups, reviews, retros and backlog refinement, with clear definitions of ready and done.
* Lead change management for every new practice. Build the plan, bring teams along, train them, measure adoption and follow through until it sticks.

* Own the cross-functional launch plan for new devices and major features.
* Coordinate with our offshore engineering teams across time zones.
* Catch the misses. Track risks, issues and dependencies across programs, escalate early, and drive them to resolution.



What success looks like

* In 30 days, you've mapped how work really moves today and agreed the operating model gaps with leadership.
* By 90 days, a documented sprint playbook is live with at least two teams, and leadership gets a regular delivery and release health report.
* By six months, teams follow a shared operating rhythm, NPI timelines are tracked against hardware gates, and adoption of new practices is measured.

**Requirements**

What you bring

* 6+ years in technical program management or delivery management, ideally at a small or fast-moving product company. Wearables or connected devices strongly preferred.
* Experience running programs that span hardware, firmware and software, where milestones have to line up.
* Strong working knowledge of SDLC workflows in Jira and Git. You don't need to write code, but engineers trust your read on technical risk.
* Deep experience running Scrum/Kanban or similar practices across multiple teams, and coaching teams through them.
* A track record of leading change: you've rolled out a new process, measured whether people adopted it, and adjusted when they didn't.
* Experience building delivery and program health metrics that leadership actually uses.
* Experience working with distributed or offshore engineering teams.

Nice to have

* Experience with hardware lifecycle gates (EVT, DVT, PVT) and contract manufacturer builds.
* Experience administering Jira, JPD or Jellyfish.

**Benefits**
**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary and benefits including 100% employer paid supplemental medical policy
* Remote working environment
* An opportunity to make a significant impact in a fast-growing company
* Generous PTO
* Collaborative, creative, and supportive work environment

Title: Director of Rooms
Description:
**Company Description**
**Raffles Hotels & Resorts**
The Birthplace of stories and legends since 1887, Raffles is a legendary brand, steeped in history and loved by generations past, present and future. Raffles, at distinguished landmark addresses around the world, is the vibrant heart of its destination, curating experiences that are culturally enriching, intellectually stimulating and always respectful of local communities, heritage and the environment.
  
  
**About Raffles The Palm**
Opened in 2021 on the western crescent of Palm Jumeirah, the world’s largest man-made island and archipelago, this palatial beach resort, featuring 340 spacious rooms, suites and villas, is inspired by the stunning elegance of European palaces and embellished with handcrafted Italian furniture. Guests can enjoy panoramic views, a private beach, state-of-the-art entertainment and recreational facilities, including specialist boutiques, a VIP movie theatre, and signature and private restaurants complemented by exquisite banqueting and conference spaces.
  
  
More than a destination, Raffles the Palm Dubai embodies the spirit of a legendary brand, celebrated for its storied heritage since 1887 and its hallmark of intuitive, gracious service. At the palace, excellence is a craft, and every team member is a master in their field. Here, talent is not only recognized, it plays a vital role in shaping the next chapter of this extraordinary resort and its legacy within the brand.
  
  
**Job Description**
The Director of Rooms and Residences leads the Rooms Division and the hotel's residences services, with overall accountability for service delivery, profitability, cost control, asset care and colleague engagement. The role ensures a consistent Raffles experience for hotel guests, individual residence owners and residents, while delivering residential services within the hotel's approved management and service agreements.
  
  
The scope includes Front Office, Concierge, Raffles Club Lounge, Royal Service, Housekeeping, Laundry, Transportation and residences services. The role is accountable for Rooms Division and residences service profitability, budget delivery and cost control, alongside guest and resident satisfaction, brand standards and operational efficiency.
  
  
**Housekeeping reporting line:**
The Director of Housekeeping reports directly to the Director of Rooms and Residences, who has full operational and financial oversight of Housekeeping and Laundry, while the Director of Housekeeping is responsible for the day-to-day delivery through the departmental teams.
  
  
**Key Roles & Responsibilities**
**Rooms Division operations**

* Lead the departments within the division, conduct daily briefings and weekly management meetings, and maintain clear ownership of operational priorities and follow-up actions.
* Maintain complete knowledge of hotel and residence services, room types and layouts, rates, packages, promotions, occupancy, arrivals and departures, pickup, availability and scheduled group activities.
* Oversee departmental rosters and Manager on Duty schedules in line with staffing guidelines and labour forecasts, adjusting coverage to business demand.
* Coordinate Front Office, Housekeeping, Royal Service and related teams to deliver timely room readiness, accurate room status, smooth arrivals and departures, and effective handling of guest requests.
* Anticipate sell-out and overbooking situations, coordinate alternative accommodation when required, and ensure affected guests receive appropriate communication and follow-up under hotel policy.
* Review out-of-order and out-of-service rooms daily with Engineering and Housekeeping, track defects and work orders, and confirm completion dates and readiness before returning rooms to inventory.

**Housekeeping & Laundry**

* Set and enforce cleaning, presentation and inspection standards for guestrooms, suites, villas, hotel-managed residences and all assigned public and back-of-house areas, including washrooms and leisure areas.
* Conduct regular inspections with the Director of Housekeeping, review room and public-area audit results, and ensure corrective actions are completed and checked.
* Oversee daily cleaning, turndown, deep cleaning and periodic maintenance programmes, coordinating access and timing with Front Office, residences services and Engineering.
* Approve departmental staffing plans and monitor productivity, attendance, overtime and casual or outsourced labour against approved budgets and required service standards.
* Control linen, uniforms, guest supplies, cleaning chemicals and amenities through agreed stock levels, secure stores, accurate inventories, controlled issuance and regular consumption reviews.
* Oversee Laundry quality, turnaround times, equipment care and outsourced service performance; investigate losses, damage, excessive consumption and recurring service failures.
* Ensure safe cleaning practices, appropriate chemical handling, pest-control coordination, lost-property procedures and respect for guest and resident privacy and property.

**Service Quality And Guest Experience**

* Work closely with Guest Experience and Butler leadership to anticipate preferences, coordinate personalised service and resolve complaints promptly, with clear follow-up and corrective action.
* Develop and enforce SOPs, review guest feedback and TrustYou results, and lead action plans for LQA, Forbes service standards and other applicable quality audits.
* Tour the property regularly, act as a Raffles brand ambassador and introduce relevant best practices that improve service consistency and operational efficiency.

**Residences operations and resident relations**

* Lead the delivery of hotel-managed residences services within the agreed operating scope, ensuring that service commitments, responsibilities and escalation routes are documented and understood.
* Serve as the senior operational contact for individual residence owners and residents, maintain regular communication and manage expectations with discretion and professionalism.
* Coordinate resident onboarding, arrivals, planned absences, departures and move-in or move-out arrangements with relevant hotel teams and appointed property representatives.
* Maintain accurate records of authorised occupants, contact details, preferences, contracted services and access permissions, with appropriate confidentiality and controlled access to information.
* Oversee residence cleaning arrangements, service schedules, inspections and optional services; clearly communicate agreed inclusions, additional charges and access requirements.
* Ensure resident requests and complaints are logged, assigned and tracked through to closure, with response and resolution targets, updates and escalation for overdue or recurring issues.
* Coordinate maintenance and preventive works with Engineering, monitor progress and communicate disruption and completion arrangements to residents; escalate unresolved defects to the Hotel Manager.
* Work with Security and relevant teams on authorised access, contractor visits, key control, emergency arrangements and protection of resident privacy and belongings.
* Monitor residential service providers within the role's remit, review service quality and coordinate matters affecting agreed common areas with the appointed property-management representatives.
* Review residence service arrangements and propose operational improvements that protect service quality and profitability; ensure approved changes are communicated clearly and applied in line with the relevant service agreements.

**Financial management and asset care**

* Prepare annual operating expense budgets and monthly, quarterly and yearly expense forecasts for the Rooms Division and residences services, using approved business forecasts; monitor profitability, explain cost variances and implement corrective actions.
* Review departmental profitability, occupancy, payroll, cost per occupied room, residence service costs, accruals and operating expenses, including uniforms, linen, supplies and amenities.
* Align staffing, supplies and service delivery with approved occupancy and business forecasts, working with Finance and relevant departments to protect profitability and maintain service standards.
* Define and monitor the allocation of shared staff, supplies and service costs between hotel and residences activities with Finance, and ensure residence service charges are supported and recorded accurately.
* Coordinate billing and payment follow-up for approved residential services with Finance; investigate discrepancies and ensure concessions or changes to charges follow delegated approval limits.
* Prepare annual capital expenditure proposals, prioritise replacement and refurbishment needs, and coordinate preventive care and defect reporting to protect rooms, residences and divisional assets.
* Review outsourced service requirements, supplier performance and costs with Procurement and Finance, ensuring commitments remain within approved budgets and authority.
* Provide the Hotel Manager with a monthly report on Rooms Division and residences profitability, Housekeeping quality, operating expenditure, guest and resident feedback, outstanding issues and corrective actions.

**People leadership**

* Lead and develop departmental managers, including the Director of Housekeeping, through coaching, training, clear objectives and regular performance feedback.
* Oversee recruitment, induction and succession planning with People and Culture, ensuring sufficient management capability across hotel and residences operations.
* Conduct annual and semi-annual management performance reviews, address performance and disciplinary matters under hotel policy, and recognise strong service delivery.
* Build an engaged, accountable and collaborative multicultural team; provide development opportunities and prepare suitable colleagues for progression.
* Ensure teams understand the different needs of hotel guests and long-term residents, including discretion, continuity of service, cultural sensitivities and ownership of requests.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum five years of luxury hotel experience in Rooms Division leadership, ideally within a resort or ultra-luxury brand, with a strong Front Office background.
* Proven experience overseeing housekeeping and laundry operations, including cleaning standards, staffing, productivity, inventories and cost control.
* Experience in branded residences, serviced residences or comparable owner and resident relations is strongly preferred.
* Ability to interpret operational service agreements, define service responsibilities and coordinate residential services with Finance, Engineering, Security and property representatives.
* Proven ability to lead large multicultural teams in a high-volume environment with empathy, presence and emotional intelligence.
* Strong understanding of luxury guest and resident expectations, personalised service, cultural sensitivities, confidentiality and service recovery.
* Strong financial and operational judgement, including expense budgeting, forecasting, cost allocation, expense control and analysis of departmental profitability.
* Experience using property-management systems, preferably Opera Cloud or similar, and operational reporting tools.
* Excellent communication, relationship management, conflict resolution and problem-solving skills, with the ability to remain calm under pressure.
* Commitment to Raffles service values, anticipatory care and thoughtful personal touches that create lasting guest and resident relationships.

Additional Information
  
  
**Employee Benefits:**
Join our team and enjoy a range of exclusive colleague perks, including complimentary upgrades, extended stays,
**discounted stays across Fairmont & Raffles properties**
, special dining and wellness discounts, and added luxuries to enhance your experience. We believe in taking care of our team, ensuring that your hard work is rewarded with exceptional benefits.

Raffles is committed to creating an inclusive environment where diverse talent thrives. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds to join our team.

This is a mandatory step for your candidacy to be considered as it enables us to explore your compatibility with this role and our culture of luxury excellence.

Title: Manager
Description:
**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Overview**
**Job Description**
The Acceptance Solutions team is part of the Value-Added Services (VAS) organization and is responsible for enabling and growing acceptance products and services across the CEMEA region.
  
  
This role will be responsible for leading Visa's acceptance localization strategy and execution across Central and Eastern Europe, Middle East, and Africa (CEMEA. The role will drive the identification, prioritization, and delivery of localization requirements necessary to support domestic payment schemes, national payment infrastructure initiatives, local routing mandates, regulatory requirements, and market-specific acceptance needs.
  
  
The successful candidate will serve as the CEMEA subject matter expert for card-present acceptance localization and will work closely with regulators, national payment companies, financial institutions, acquirers, processors, merchants, and internal Visa stakeholders to ensure Visa's in-person acceptance capabilities support local market requirements and evolving payment ecosystem needs.
  
  
This role will partner extensively with Global Product teams, Core Processing and Network teams, Technology teams, Government Engagement, Legal, Risk, and Compliance organizations to assess market requirements, define product and processing enhancements, influence product roadmaps, and drive the delivery of localization initiatives across the acceptance ecosystem.
  
  
The successful candidate will be responsible for developing regional localization strategies, conducting market and regulatory assessments, translating local requirements into actionable business and technical specifications, supporting client engagements, and ensuring successful deployment of localized acceptance capabilities across CEMEA markets.
  
  
This position would be ideal for a candidate with extensive experience in merchant acquiring, payment acceptance, payment processing, domestic payment schemes, regulatory programs, or in-person payments product management. The role is part of the hub team covering the CEMEA region and will report to the Acceptance Solutions Lead within the VAS organization.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Be the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for in-person acceptance localization across CEMEA, covering merchant acquiring, acceptance infrastructure, card-present payments, domestic payment schemes, and local routing initiatives.
* Lead Visa's regional strategy for localization of in-person acceptance capabilities to address regulatory requirements, domestic payment scheme mandates, and national payment infrastructure initiatives.
* Analyze and translate regulatory, market, and domestic scheme requirements into clearly documented business, operational, and technical requirements.
* Partner with regulators, central banks, national payment companies, and government stakeholders to understand evolving payment ecosystem requirements and represent Visa's acceptance capabilities.
* Work closely with Government Engagement, Legal, Risk, Compliance, and Regional Product teams to assess the impact of local payment requirements and define Visa's response strategy.
* Collaborate with Global Product, Technology, Acceptance Solutions, and Core Processing teams to build business cases, prioritize market requirements, and drive product roadmap enhancements.
* Partner with VisaNet, network processing, and core processing teams to evaluate technical implications of localization initiatives and identify scalable implementation approaches.
* Drive end-to-end execution of localization initiatives including requirements gathering, impact assessments, stakeholder alignment, business case development, delivery tracking, testing, certification support, and market readiness activities.
* Support domestic payment scheme enablement initiatives, including co-badging programs, local routing, domestic acceptance mandates, and national payment infrastructure projects.
* Assess acquiring, processing, and acceptance ecosystem readiness to support market-specific payment requirements.
* Engage with acquirers, processors, payment service providers (PSPs), payment facilitators, terminal vendors, merchants, fintechs, and ecosystem participants to understand implementation challenges and support deployment readiness.
* Identify product gaps and regional customization requirements and work with global teams to prioritize and deliver solutions addressing local market needs.
* Develop market assessments, strategy recommendations, and executive-level updates to support regional and global decision-making.
* Be responsible for annual planning activities for localization initiatives, including KPI setting, strategic priorities, delivery objectives, and cross-functional alignment.
* Monitor progress of localization programs and provide regular updates to senior leadership on market readiness, implementation status, risks, and dependencies.
* Represent Visa at industry forums, regulatory discussions, market working groups, and client engagements related to payment acceptance, domestic schemes, and localization initiatives.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, Finance, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in payments, merchant acquiring, card-present acceptance, payment processing, fintech, or related industries.
* Deep expertise in merchant acquiring, payment acceptance ecosystems, and card-present payment processing.
* Proven experience working with financial institutions, acquirers, processors, payment service providers, merchants, fintechs, payment networks, or national payment organizations.
* Strong knowledge of card-present payments, including:

+ EMV chip acceptance
+ Contactless payments
+ NFC technologies
+ SoftPOS / Tap-to-Phone
+ Android POS
+ Unattended commerce
+ Transit acceptance
+ Mobile wallet acceptance
+ QR-based acceptance solutions

* Strong understanding of payment processing and transaction lifecycles, including authorization, clearing, settlement, routing, switching, and acquiring architectures.

Title: IT Audit Manager
Description:
We are seeking IT Audit Manager to join our team and lead audits across Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Business Continuity Management (BCM), and other technology-enabled business processes. The Senior IT Auditor will be responsible for planning and executing risk-based audits, evaluating the design and operating effectiveness of IT general controls (ITGCs), cybersecurity controls, technology governance, cloud environments, business continuity and disaster recovery capabilities, and regulatory compliance. The role also involves identifying technology risks and control deficiencies, assessing their impact on the organization, and providing practical recommendations to strengthen governance, enhance cyber resilience, improve operational effectiveness, and support compliance with applicable regulatory requirements and industry standards.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Plan and execute risk-based IT audit engagements, including IT General Controls (ITGC), cybersecurity, cloud computing, digital platforms, data governance, business continuity management (BCM), disaster recovery (DR), third-party risk, and technology-enabled business processes.
  
  
Perform audit planning activities, including risk assessments, audit scoping, control identification, and development of audit programs and testing procedures.
  
  
Evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of IT controls, identify technology risks and control deficiencies, and provide practical recommendations to strengthen governance, security, resilience, and operational effectiveness.
  
  
Assess compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, internal policies, and recognized industry frameworks and standards, including SAMA Cybersecurity Framework (CSF), SAMA BCM Framework, PCI DSS, ISO/IEC 27001, COBIT, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, SWIFT CSCF (where applicable), and other relevant technology risk and security standards.
  
  
Conduct interviews and walkthroughs with business and technology stakeholders to obtain an understanding of IT processes, systems, applications, infrastructure, and associated controls.
  
  
Prepare clear, concise, and evidence-based audit reports, working papers, and executive presentations that effectively communicate audit observations, risk implications, and actionable recommendations.
  
  
Present audit findings and recommendations to senior management and facilitate discussions to obtain agreement on corrective action plans.
  
  
Monitor and validate the implementation of agreed management actions through periodic follow-up reviews and provide independent assurance over the effectiveness of remediation activities, including validation of regulatory observations where required.
  
  
Build and maintain effective working relationships with business units, technology teams, risk management, compliance, and external stakeholders while preserving audit independence and objectivity.
  
  
Stay abreast of emerging technology risks, cybersecurity threats, evolving regulatory requirements, and changes to applicable auditing, governance, and security standards.
  
  
Provide advisory and consulting services on technology initiatives, digital transformation projects, system implementations, and other ad hoc reviews, while maintaining the independence of the Internal Audit function.
  
  
Contribute to the continuous enhancement of the Internal Audit methodology, including the adoption of data analytics, continuous auditing techniques, and technology-enabled audit tools.

Title: Senior Manager, Technical Support
Description:
Ingram Micro is a leading technology company for the global information technology ecosystem. With the ability to reach nearly 90% of the global population, we play a vital role in the worldwide IT sales channel, bringing products and services from technology manufacturers and cloud providers to business-to-business technology experts. Our market reach, diverse solutions and services portfolio, and digital platform Ingram Micro Xvantage™ set us apart. Learn more at www.ingrammicro.com
  
  
**Ingram Micro has earned Great Place**
**to**
**Work Certification™ for 2026-2027 in Canada! This prestigious recognition reflects our commitment to our people and our culture. Ingram Micro Canada has also been recognized on the Canadian 2026 Best Workplaces in Technology list and the Best Workplace for Giving Back.**
**Come join our team where you’ll make technology happen in surprising ways. Let’s shape tomorrow -It’ll be a fun Journey!**
**This position is a hybrid role based in our Mississauga office where your will work 3 days in the office and 2 days remotely.**
**Role:**
Lead Ingram Micro's global cloud support operations for AWS Partner-Led Support today, with other vendor lines to follow. When a customer's AWS production environment goes down, our team is who they call. Ingram Micro delivers AWS Partner-Led Support to end customers who buy AWS through our reseller partners, and you'll lead the global team that resolves their toughest issues. You'll lead senior engineers and Technical Account Managers across time zones, and you'll be the technical leader in the room on high-impact escalations: challenging assumptions, unblocking diagnosis and coordinating with customers, resellers and AWS. You'll also shape how we scale support through AI, automation and self-service.
  
  
**You'll stand out if**
you can walk us through an AWS incident you personally diagnosed: what you checked, what you ruled out and what fixed it. A distinguished leadership style overseeing a global team ranging from engineers, technical account managers, supervisors, and managers.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
**Lead and grow the team:**

* Lead senior engineers and Technical Account Managers across regions: hiring, coaching, performance, capacity planning and handoffs between time zones.
* Build leadership depth, succession and clear growth paths as the service expands to more vendors.

**Lead escalations and set the technical bar:**

* Provide technical direction for high-impact incidents across AWS compute, storage, networking, identity, operating systems and databases in diverse and end customer environments.
* Guide network troubleshooting across VPCs, subnets, route tables, security groups, network ACLs, DNS, load balancers, VPNs, and hybrid connectivity; distinguish connectivity, configuration, application, and AWS service issues.
* Guide database troubleshooting involving Amazon RDS/Aurora and database engines, including connectivity, query latency, resource bottlenecks, locking, replication, failover, and backup or recovery issues. Require evidence-based diagnosis using logs, metrics, configuration, and relevant diagnostic tools.

**Scale the service:**

* Introduce AI capabilities: agent copilots, conversational support, automated diagnostics and intelligent case routing.
* Build a knowledge base using Knowledge-Centered Service (KCS) so customers and engineers resolve issues faster.
* Use support data and customer feedback to find recurring issues, and work with AWS, Product and Engineering to fix them at the source.

**Run the operation:**

* Own the metrics: mean time to resolution (MTTR), SLA compliance, backlog health, quality, customer satisfaction (CSAT) and self-service adoption.
* Present incidents, trends, risks and improvement plans to customer executives, partners and senior leadership.
* Lead cross-functional work with AWS, Product, Engineering, Sales and regional operations, often without direct authority.

**What success looks like in your first year:**

* Faster, more consistent resolution of customer incidents in every region.
* Escalations to AWS that are evidence-based and resolved sooner.
* AI and self-service tools reducing repeat cases.
* A team with clear standards, growth paths and a strong leadership bench.
* Cross functional handling across hardware/software and vendor lines.
* New vendor lines onboarded to the same operating standard.

**What you bring to the role:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, IT or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Minimum 8+ years in technical support, cloud operations or IT services, including substantial hands-on troubleshooting in customers' AWS production environments.
* 3+ years of leading managers, including hiring, performance management and development.
* Experience leading team leads or managers is a strong plus.
* Practical AWS networking knowledge: VPCs, routing, security groups, network ACLs, DNS, load balancing, VPN and hybrid connectivity. You can trace a network path and isolate where it breaks.
* Practical database troubleshooting with Amazon RDS/Aurora and MySQL or PostgreSQL: connectivity, performance, locking, replication, availability and recovery.
* Working knowledge of EC2, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, the AWS CLI and operating-system diagnostics.
* Experience leading teams across time zones and managing critical escalations in an enterprise, multifunctional environment.
* Must be able to communicate clearly and calmly with executives, particularly during high-pressure situations or incidents.
* Support leadership at an AWS partner, managed service provider, distributor or cloud support provider would be a strong asset.
* Multi-vendor technical support experience across cloud, networking or security would be an asset.
* Experience introducing AI support tools, automated diagnostics, KCS or self-service would be an asset.
* AWS certifications in architecture, operations or networking would be an asset.

Title: Director, IT Operations

Reporting to the SVP, Technology, this role owns the reliability, security, and performance of all IT systems and services across the organization — infrastructure, endpoints, identity, collaboration, and end-user support. The Director leads a small internal IT operations team and directs our Managed Service Provider (MSP), owns the IT operations budget and roadmap, and partners with information security, HR, and business leaders to keep systems available, compliant, and cost-effective as the company scales.
  
  
**The Work**

* Own the reliability, performance, and security of the company's technology environment — network, endpoints, servers, cloud and hybrid workloads, and collaboration systems.
* Lead planned network infrastructure modernization, including a firewall and switch refresh.
* Administer the Microsoft 365 environment, including tenant configuration, licensing, mail flow, and security baselines.
* Direct endpoint management and device lifecycle — provisioning, Microsoft Intune (MDM), patching, imaging, and refresh — across an on-site and hybrid workforce.
* Own the IT service desk and end-user experience, defining and meeting service-level agreements (SLAs) for response and resolution.
* Operate identity and access management within Microsoft Entra ID, including SSO, MFA, conditional access, and least-privilege/role-based access.
* Own the technology portion of user onboarding, offboarding, and role changes in close coordination with HR — account and license provisioning, equipment, role-based access, and timely deprovisioning (same-day for involuntary separations).
* Serve as the primary owner of the MSP relationship, directing scope and priorities, managing performance against SLAs, and defining the split between internal and MSP-delivered work.
* Direct IT hardware and software procurement, standardization, and asset and license inventory; manage carriers and technology vendors, including contracts, SLAs, performance reviews, and renewals.
* Continuously monitor IT systems for performance and reliability, proactively addressing issues to minimize downtime and maintain operational efficiency.
* Operate core security controls in partnership with information security leadership — vulnerability and patch management, endpoint protection, logging, and email security.
* Own business continuity and disaster recovery, including backups, recovery testing, and incident-response readiness.

**GENERAL DUTIES**

* Own the IT operations budget; forecast, track, and report spend, including cloud and SaaS cost optimization.
* Build and maintain the IT operations roadmap aligned to company growth, headcount, and facilities plans, such as office moves and new sites.
* Lead, coach, and develop the internal IT operations team.
* Develop, enforce, and update IT policies, standards, runbooks, and best practices to support a secure and efficient technology environment.
* Identify and implement automation and AI-assisted operations to improve efficiency, reliability, and self-service.
* Maintain detailed documentation of system configurations, vendor agreements, and IT processes.
* Lead IT projects from conception to completion — including risk management and mitigation.
* Support compliance and audit programs (e.g., SOC 2) by maintaining accurate IT and control documentation and remediating findings.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and vendor offerings to enhance IT capabilities and streamline operations, working with the MSP where appropriate.
* Provide regular updates and clear communication on IT initiatives, risks, and progress to executives and cross-functional teams.

**Your Skills and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 8+ years in IT operations or infrastructure, including 3+ years leading staff and/or managing an MSP and vendors, preferably in real estate finance or another regulated industry.
* Demonstrated ownership of enterprise infrastructure, identity, endpoint management, and Microsoft 365.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Entra ID and Microsoft Intune (MDM).
* Strong networking and security fundamentals — firewalls, VPN, segmentation, Zero Trust principles, and IAM.
* Cisco Meraki experience a plus.
* Experience running an IT service management (ITSM)/service-desk function and meeting defined SLAs, plus budget ownership and vendor/contract negotiation.
* Experience supporting compliance frameworks (e.g., SOC 2) and business continuity/disaster recovery.
* Relevant certifications preferred (e.g., ITIL, Microsoft M365/Azure, CISSP, or Security+).
* Excellent leadership, project management, communication, and problem-solving skills.

**The Pay**
Salary range is up to $180,000 per year, with a discretionary bonus of 15% per year
  
  
**The Work Environment**

* This role works on-site from Ascent's Encino office, Monday - Thursday (Fridays are work-from-home).

**Our Benefits**
We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, well-being, and work-life balance. Title: Director IT Operations
Description:
**Position:**
***Director, IT Operations***
Monogram Health is seeking an experienced
**Director, IT Operations**
to run the day-to-day operation of our enterprise IT environment end-to-end. Reporting to the VP of Cloud Engineering, this leader is the operational counterpart to the VP's architectural and platform mandate: where the VP defines how our cloud and platform foundations are designed, the Director is accountable for how they run — alongside endpoint, identity, collaboration, network, and service management.
  
  
This is a hands-on operational leadership role for someone who blends classic IT service management discipline with modern Site Reliability Engineering practices. The Director ensures that core IT services, infrastructure, and platforms are reliable, secure, cost-effective, and demonstrably improving over time, measured by service levels, employee experience, and operational maturity, not just uptime.
  
  
This role partners closely with Cloud Engineering, Security, Applications, Data, and Business leaders, and is expected to operate as a peer-level technical leader who can push back constructively when operational realities require it. This position reports to the Vice President, Cloud Engineering.
  
  
**The Director, IT Operations Owns The Operation Of**

* Microsoft Azure environments (IaaS, PaaS, and supporting services) — operating to the architectural standards and platform patterns set by Cloud Engineering
* Enterprise networking — operating cloud networks, VPN, firewalls, and connectivity between on-premises, cloud, and remote users
* Identity & access — Microsoft Entra ID, conditional access, RBAC, and identity lifecycle
* Microsoft 365 services — Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive
* Endpoint and user productivity platforms — device lifecycle, patching, and support
* IT service management — incident, problem, change, release, and request management
* Service monitoring, observability, and operational tooling across the IT estate

**Responsibilities**

* Run end-to-end IT operations across cloud, network, identity, endpoint, and collaboration platforms
* Establish and operate Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and error budgets alongside traditional SLAs; use them to drive prioritization between reliability work and change velocity
* Lead incident response and major incident command for IT services; drive post-incident reviews and ensure systemic remediation
* Operate mature ITSM practices (incident, problem, change, release) and continuously evolve them — moving routine change toward automated, pipeline-driven flow while preserving controls
* Operate resilient compute, storage, networking, backup, and disaster recovery in Microsoft Azure to the standards set by Cloud Engineering
* Run cloud networking, VPN, firewall operations, and secure connectivity between on-premises, cloud, and remote users
* Own operational readiness for new systems, applications, and platform changes — including go/no-go authority for production cutover
* Operate Microsoft Entra ID, conditional access, and RBAC in partnership with Security; own identity hygiene and lifecycle execution
* Ensure reliable, performant delivery of Microsoft 365 services across the enterprise
* Improve the employee IT experience through automation, self-service, and modern workplace tooling; measure it with experience-level metrics (XLAs), not just ticket SLAs
* Ensure reliable IT connectivity and service delivery for corporate and clinical operations
* Promote and operationalize Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and configuration management in alignment with Cloud Engineering's standards
* Drive automation for provisioning, monitoring, patching, and routine operational tasks; measure and reduce manual toil
* Selectively adopt emerging automation and AI-assisted tooling where it materially improves reliability, response time, or employee experience
* Standardize platforms, reduce technical debt, and improve operational maturity over time
* Partner with Security to operationalize security controls, vulnerability management, and incident response
* Ensure IT operations meet HIPAA, HITRUST, and internal risk management requirements through evidenced, auditable practices
* Own operational evidence for audits — logging, access reviews, change records, and configuration baselines
* Drive FinOps practices across cloud and infrastructure platforms in partnership with Cloud Engineering
* Own the IT operations budget, forecasting, and vendor spend optimization
* Manage vendor and managed service provider relationships, including Microsoft
* Build, lead, and develop high-performing IT operations teams and managers; set career paths for operations engineers, SREs, and service managers
* Foster strong working relationships with Security, Applications, Data, and Business leadership
* Translate clinical and business needs into reliable, secure, well-operated IT services

**Position Requirements**

* Minimum of seven (7) years in enterprise IT infrastructure and operations, including a minimum of three (3) years in an IT leadership role with production accountability
* Demonstrated experience operating Microsoft-centric environments at scale (Azure and Microsoft 365)
* Working knowledge of modern operational practices — SLOs, error budgets, postmortems, observability — layered onto a foundation of mature ITSM
* Track record of partnering with cloud architecture and platform engineering leaders
* Experience driving automation and reducing manual toil through IaC and operational tooling
* Proficiency with FinOps, vendor management, and managed service provider experience
* Prior experience in healthcare or other regulated environments (HIPAA/HITRUST a plus)
* Relevant Microsoft and/or ITSM certifications a plus

**Compensation**
The base salary range for this role is $135,000 to $175,000 and reflects the range of experience and qualifications we may consider. Final compensation will be determined based on geographic location and job-related factors such as experience, skills, education, certifications, and internal compensation considerations. While a larger range is posted, most offers will typically fall within a narrower band based on these factors.
  
  
In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for additional compensation, including bonus opportunities and a comprehensive benefits package.
  
  
**Benefits**

* Comprehensive Benefits - Medical, dental, and vision insurance, employee assistance program, employer-paid and voluntary life insurance, disability insurance, plus health and flexible spending accounts
* Financial & Retirement Support – Competitive compensation, 401k with employer match, and financial wellness resources
* Time Off & Leave – 20 PTO days, 7 paid holidays, and 1 floating day to make your own, and paid parental leave
* Wellness & Growth – Work life assistance resources, physical wellness perks, mental health support, employee referral program, and BenefitHub for employee discounts

Title: Head of Applied Science and AI Delivery
Description:
This is your opportunity to join AXIS Capital – a trusted global provider of specialty lines insurance and reinsurance. We stand apart for our outstanding client service, intelligent risk taking and superior risk adjusted returns for our shareholders. We also proudly maintain an entrepreneurial, disciplined and ethical corporate culture. As a member of AXIS, you join a team that is among the best in the industry.

At AXIS, we believe that we are only as strong as our people. We strive to create an inclusive and welcoming culture where employees of all backgrounds and from all walks of life feel comfortable and empowered to be themselves. This means that we bring our whole selves to work.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic, including age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity, marital status, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any basis prohibited by the laws that govern its operations.

**How does this role contribute to our collective success?**  
Data, analytics and AI are critical to AXIS’s ability to make confident decisions, identify opportunities, improve efficiency and create sustainable competitive advantage. The Head of Applied Science & AI Delivery leads the development, management and evolution of AXIS’s portfolio of reusable applied science and AI capabilities.  
Rather than owning delivery for individual business initiatives, this role provides the shared services, models, frameworks, engineering patterns and specialist expertise that enable and support delivery of high-quality business solutions rapidly, safely and consistently. The role is accountable for creating scalable, governed capabilities that can be adopted across multiple value streams, reducing duplication and accelerating value from analytics and AI.

**What will you do in this role?**

* Set the platform vision and roadmap: Define and communicate the strategy, architecture and investment roadmap for reusable data science and AI capabilities, aligned with AXIS’s business priorities, enterprise technology strategy and Data & Analytics operating model.
* Build reusable capabilities: Lead the design and development of shared AI services, analytical models, accelerators, agent frameworks, evaluation frameworks, experimentation environments and common solution components that can be adopted across multiple business-aligned solutions.
* Enable business-aligned delivery: Partner closely with the Head of Insights & Analytics and value-stream teams to understand recurring needs, translate them into platform priorities and ensure capabilities are practical, discoverable, well documented and easy to adopt.
* Lead experimentation and innovation: Create a controlled environment for exploration of emerging analytics, machine learning, generative AI and agentic capabilities. Convert successful experimentation into supported, repeatable enterprise components where there is clear value.
* Establish product and platform management: Manage analytics and AI capabilities as products through their full lifecycle, with clear ownership, roadmaps, service expectations, adoption measures, technical health indicators and plans for continuous improvement or retirement.
* Lead technical standards and engineering excellence: Establish consistent patterns for development, testing, deployment, integration, monitoring, observability, version control, documentation and reuse. Ensure capabilities are robust, maintainable and designed for enterprise scale.
* Drive responsible and governed AI: Partner with Data & AI Governance, Information Risk Management, Legal, Compliance and Technology teams to embed responsible AI, model risk management, security, privacy and regulatory requirements into platform capabilities by design.
* Own evaluation and monitoring frameworks: Ensure reusable approaches are in place to evaluate model and agent quality, performance, reliability, safety and value, and to monitor deployed capabilities throughout their lifecycle.
* Advance the technology ecosystem: Work closely with Data Platforms & Engineering and Business Technology Solutions to shape and implement the analytics and AI technology stack, integration patterns and deployment pathways across Azure and Databricks.
* Build and lead a high-performing specialist team: Lead and develop a multidisciplinary team of data scientists, applied scientists and AI engineers. Set a high bar for technical and academic rigour while fostering collaboration, inclusion, curiosity and pragmatic delivery.
* Manage demand, capacity and investment: Prioritise the platform backlog based on enterprise value, reuse potential, risk reduction and strategic fit. Manage resources, budgets, suppliers and delivery commitments transparently.
* Champion adoption and reuse: Promote awareness and effective use of shared capabilities, provide technical enablement to delivery teams and actively identify opportunities to consolidate duplicated solutions or patterns

**How this role works with Insights & Analytics**

The Insights & Analytics teams are aligned to business value streams and are accountable for identifying opportunities, defining priorities, designing solutions for each business need, delivering business-aligned solutions and driving adoption and measurable value. The Analytics & AI Platforms team is accountable for the reusable technical capabilities, frameworks, standards and specialist expertise that enable those teams to deliver at greater speed, quality and scale.

Both teams share accountability for successful end-to-end outcomes. The platform team does not become a central delivery queue for every use case, and business-aligned teams should reuse enterprise capabilities wherever practical rather than creating parallel solutions.

**Success Measures / Key Outcomes**

* Reuse and adoption: Shared analytics and AI capabilities are adopted across multiple value streams, with evidence that reuse is reducing duplicated effort and accelerating delivery.
* Speed and scalability: Business-aligned teams can move from opportunity to production more quickly because common services, patterns and deployment pathways are available and reliable.
* Quality and reliability: Platform capabilities meet agreed standards for performance, availability, maintainability, documentation, monitoring and support.
* Responsible delivery: Analytics and AI capabilities operate within AXIS governance, security, privacy, model risk and responsible AI requirements, with effective controls embedded by design.
* Business enablement: Capability investments are demonstrably connected to priority business outcomes and enable solutions that are adopted and deliver measurable value.
* Technology modernisation: The portfolio evolves in a controlled way to take advantage of relevant advances in data science, machine learning, generative AI and agentic technology.
* Team performance: A highly engaged, inclusive and technically strong team with clear accountabilities, effective development pathways and a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Cost and portfolio discipline: Investment is focused on capabilities with enterprise value and reuse potential, with transparent management of cost, technical debt, suppliers and lifecycle decisions.

**About You**  
We encourage you to bring your own experience and expertise to the table. While there are qualifications and experiences we need you to have, we are open to discussing how your individual knowledge may help you fulfil this role and contribute to our goals.

**What you need to have**

* Platform and product leadership: Significant experience defining and delivering a platform, product or reusable capability strategy in a complex organisation, with accountability for roadmaps, prioritisation, adoption and lifecycle management.
* Technical leadership: Deep experience in data science, machine learning and AI, including generative AI, with the credibility to set technical direction, challenge design decisions and lead senior specialists.
* Insurance or financial services experience: Understanding of the data, analytical, regulatory and risk context of insurance or another highly regulated industry.
* Enterprise AI engineering: Strong understanding of how analytical models and AI services are developed, evaluated, deployed, monitored and operated at scale, including modern software engineering and MLOps or LLMOps practices.
* Cloud and data platforms: Strong knowledge of Azure AI services and Azure Databricks, together with practical understanding of enterprise data architectures, APIs, deployment pipelines and integration patterns.
* Responsible AI and risk: Experience embedding governance, security, privacy, controls and responsible AI practices into the design and operation of analytics and AI capabilities.
* Strategic and commercial judgement: Ability to balance innovation, speed, enterprise value, cost, risk and technical sustainability when making platform investment and prioritisation decisions.
* Collaborative operating style: Demonstrated success working across business-aligned analytics teams, engineering, architecture, technology, governance and senior stakeholders to deliver shared outcomes without relying solely on direct authority.
* People leadership: Proven ability to build, lead and develop multidisciplinary technical teams and create a high-performance, inclusive and learning-oriented culture.
* Communication and influence: Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts, choices and risks clearly to executives, business leaders and delivery teams.
* Delivery leadership: Ability to operate in a fast-paced environment, manage multiple priorities and provide clear direction, resource planning, cost oversight and delivery transparency.

**What we prefer you to have**

* Relevant technical background: Advanced technical education or equivalent professional experience in data science, computer science, statistics, engineering or a related field.
* Enterprise implementation experience: A track record of building reusable analytics or AI platforms and taking generative AI or agentic capabilities from experimentation into governed enterprise use.
* Technical depth: Strong working knowledge of Python, Databricks, foundational models, evaluation techniques, retrieval patterns, agent architectures, deployment pipelines and monitoring approaches.

**Role Factors**

* Attend your local office in line with AXIS expectations to build relationships with colleagues and the wider business.
* Engage in company activities to grow your network and build a strong team culture.
* Travel internationally on occasion, as required by the role.

**What we offer**  
You will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes medical plans for you and your family, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid annual leave, and much more.

*For this position, we currently expect to offer a base salary in the range of $280,000.00 to $325,000.00. Your salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors including your specific experience and work location.*

*In addition, you will be offered competitive target incentive compensation, with awards based on overall corporate and individual performance. On top of this, you will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes medical plans for you and your family, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation, and much more.*

Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
  
  
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
  
  
The role of a Silicon Alliances Ecosystem Development Manager at Canonical
  
  
Ubuntu is the fastest growing enterprise Linux, the leading platform for public cloud computing, and the engineer's favorite way to drive the future.
  
  
Our goal is to help the enterprise embrace open source from end to end, across every class of compute and every class of application, starting with the linux kernel itself, to infrastructure solutions like OpenStack and Kubernetes, all the way up to data, security, analytics and serverless capabilities.
  
  
The Silicon Alliances Team works with the leading semiconductor companies to combine open source adoption with innovative optimizations to get the most from each new chip. With our semiconductor partners, we develop joint product roadmaps, drive delivery, formulate go-to-market plans and conceptualize new business models, enabling differentiated hardware and robust product life-cycle support while still anchored to best-in-class Ubuntu. The end goal is a frictionless experience to deploy, maintain, and develop on any hardware from cloud to edge.
  
  
The successful candidate is someone who is passionate about both hardware and software technology with interest to grow into business development. We are hiring for positions across early career to senior roles, with scope ranging from small exploratory partnerships to managing our largest and most strategic partnerships.
  
  
If you are someone who can navigate complex new technical challenges, learn quickly, and architect solutions and strategies across global teams, this challenging role is for you.
  
  
**Location:**
We are hiring for remote roles in Americas. We will also consider applicants in EMEA who can accommodate a shifted schedule to support Silicon partners in Americas. Global travel to sprints, events, and partner meetings is part of the role.
  
  
What your day will look like
  
  

* Represent Canonical, its solutions and software to partners.
* Develop a deep understanding of silicon partner strategies, technologies and roadmaps and identify overlap with Canonical’s current and future products.
* Work cross-functionally with engineering, product, marketing and sales teams to facilitate new business, leading definition of joint products, solutions and complex programs relying heavily on your communicating and influencing skills.
* Ensure that robust project plans are created, tracked, and executed.
* Develop joint Go To Market strategy and campaigns with silicon partners, manage market messaging, collateral and launch plans across products.
* Negotiate successful contracts.

What we are looking for in you
  
  

* B.A / B.S / B.E degree in science, technology and/or engineering.
* Fundamental understanding of the semiconductor industry and ecosystem.
* Experience in software and system architecture is preferred.
* Customer-facing experience in business development, technology strategy or similar functions.
* Excellent communication skills; ability to grasp complex material and synthesize key points.
* Ability to think and work at both strategic and tactical levels
* Disciplined and self motivated for a remote-first workplace environment.

**Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring**

* Experience with open source software and open source business models is preferred.
* Team leadership or program management experience.

What we offer you
  
  
Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.
  
  
In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.
  
  

* Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!
* Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
* Annual compensation review
* Recognition rewards
* Annual holiday leave
* Parental Leave
* Employee Assistance Programme
* Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’
* Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

**About Canonical**
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
