The Vertical Operations Director is responsible for owning and scaling the operational performance of Snoonu’s key business verticals, including grocery, laundry, ticketing, and any future verticals launched under Snoonu’s ecosystem.
  
  
This role ensures that each vertical operates with clear ownership, strong execution, high service quality, and profitable growth, while maintaining Snoonu’s customer obsession and operational standards.
  
  
The Vertical Operations Director is not only responsible for day-to-day operations, but also for building scalable operating models, improving unit economics, solving cross-functional issues, and ensuring that each Non-food vertical is ready to grow in Qatar and future markets.
  
  
**🛠 What You’ll Get Your Hands On**

* Grocery Operations

Own the operational performance of grocery, supermarket, convenience, and quick-commerce partners.
  
  

* Ensure product availability, stock accuracy, pricing accuracy, and substitution processes are properly managed.
* Reduce missing items, wrong items, out-of-stock issues, and delayed grocery orders.
* Improve picking, packing, and handover processes with partners.
* Work with category, merchant, logistics, and product teams to improve the grocery customer journey.
* Build operating standards for grocery partners, including item accuracy, cold-chain sensitivity, packaging, and delivery readiness.
* Monitor grocery fulfillment time and customer complaint trends.
* Support the development of dark-store or quick-commerce models if required.
* Improve grocery basket experience, repeat purchase, and reliability.
* Laundry Operations

Own the operational performance of laundry partners and end-to-end laundry order flow.
  
  

* Manage the full laundry journey from pickup to partner processing to delivery.
* Ensure clear SLAs for pickup, cleaning, ironing, packaging, and return delivery.
* Reduce delays, damaged items, missing items, wrong items, and customer complaints.
* Build quality control standards for laundry partners.
* Ensure proper item tagging, tracking, and handover processes.
* Work with product and logistics teams to improve scheduling, pickup windows, and customer notifications.
* Create escalation processes for high-value items, lost items, or damaged items.
* Improve customer trust in the laundry vertical through reliability, transparency, and service recovery.
* Ticketing Operations

Own the operational execution of ticketing services, events, bookings, and related customer experiences.
  
  

* Ensure ticket inventory, availability, pricing, and event details are accurate.
* Coordinate with event organizers, venues, partners, product, finance, and customer support.
* Manage operational readiness before, during, and after major events.
* Reduce customer issues related to ticket access, QR codes, refunds, cancellations, and event changes.
* Create clear SOPs for event-day support and escalation.
* Ensure smooth settlement and reporting with ticketing partners.
* Support major event launches with risk assessment and operational planning.
* Build scalable ticketing processes for future expansion into entertainment, experiences, sports, and tourism.

**Additional Verticals And Business Areas**
Based on Snoonu’s business model, the Vertical Operations Director may also oversee or support the following areas:
  
  

* Retail Operations

For flowers, pharmacies, electronics, beauty, gifts, fashion, and general retail partners.
  
  

* Improving item accuracy, merchant readiness, fulfillment time, packaging, and delivery handover.
* Reducing cancellations, unavailable items, wrong items, and poor packaging complaints.
* Building SOPs for sensitive categories such as pharmacy, flowers, electronics, and gifts.
* Supporting category-specific service standards.
* Marketplace Operations

Own the overall marketplace health across multiple verticals.
  
  

* Monitor supply availability across merchants and categories.
* Ensure strong coordination between merchant operations, logistics, product, and customer support.
* Improve operational KPIs across all marketplace verticals.
* Identify marketplace gaps such as low availability, weak fulfillment, poor merchant compliance, or high complaint rates.
* Support new vertical launches with proper operating models and readiness checks.
* New Vertical Launch Operations

Lead operational readiness for new Snoonu verticals before launch.
  
  

* Define the operating model for each new vertical.
* Build SOPs, SLAs, partner requirements, customer support flows, and escalation rules.
* Run pilot launches before scaling.

Title: Service Desk Team Lead
Description:
**Job Summary**

The Service Desk Team Lead owns the day-to-day performance of the Service Desk and client satisfaction. You will lead a team of Level 1 and Level 2 helpdesk engineers, act as the team's technical escalation point, manage the team's workload so tickets are handled on time and to a high standard, and provide clear reporting on service desk health to the Vice President of Service Delivery.

**Duties**

* Lead, coach and develop a team of helpdesk engineers, including regular one-on-ones, performance feedback and onboarding of new team members
* Handle day-to-day people management: take part in hiring and interviews, run weekly team meetings, complete performance reviews, approve time off and plan shift coverage
* Manage the team's workload: monitor queues, assign and balance tickets, prioritize by urgency and impact, and plan coverage and schedules
* Make sure tickets meet SLA targets and quality standards, and step in on escalations and at-risk tickets
* Own escalation paths between Level 1, Level 2 and other Conpute teams, and make sure handoffs are clean
* Own and report on service desk KPIs, including SLA compliance, first response time, time to resolution, first contact resolution, ticket backlog, escalation rate, ticket reopen rate and customer satisfaction (CSAT)
* Produce regular reporting for the Sr. Director, including ticket volume, workload by engineer and recurring issues
* Use reporting and KPIs to identify trends, root causes and capacity needs, guide coaching and staffing decisions, and recommend improvements to the Sr. Director
* Own service desk documentation in IT Glue: keep SOPs, runbooks and escalation procedures accurate and current, and make sure engineers document their work
* Maintain and improve service desk processes and ticket quality
* Run the service desk day to day in Autotask and N-able RMM, including queues, tickets, SLAs and client alerts
* Act as the technical escalation point for the Service Desk, resolving complex issues that Level 1 and Level 2 engineers cannot, and as the point of contact for escalations from clients and internal teams
* Work with Account Management, Projects, and AI and Development to improve service delivery

**Qualifications**

* Experience working in a managed service provider (MSP) environment
* Previous management experience
* Direct experience managing a team of helpdesk engineers
* Demonstrated ability to manage team workload, queues and SLAs
* Experience tracking and reporting service desk KPIs and presenting results to senior leadership
* Hands-on experience with an MSP PSA, RMM and documentation platform
* Strong documentation habits, with experience maintaining SOPs, runbooks and knowledge base articles
* Strong hands-on technical skills across Microsoft 365, Windows, networking and common end-user and small business IT support, with a proven ability to troubleshoot complex issues and serve as the technical escalation point for a support team
* Clear written and verbal communication with clients and staff

**Preferred qualifications**

* Direct experience with Autotask, IT Glue and N-able RMM

Title: Associate Project Director (Residential)
Description:
Mace combines construction expertise with consultancy to unlock potential in every person or project and redefine the boundaries of ambition. Our values shape the way we consult and define the people we want to join us on our journey.

**The project**

Mace is providing project management consultancy services on a major mixed-use development in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

This is an opportunity to join an ambitious programme, supporting the delivery of a significant new-build residential development from design through construction and handover.

As Associate Project Director, you will provide senior project management leadership and control across the full project lifecycle, from concept and pre-contract stages through procurement, construction, commissioning, and handover.

The successful candidate will bring strong front-end, design, and development experience alongside proven construction delivery capability.

You will work closely with the development and design functions, providing project management oversight, structure, and control during the critical early stages of the programme before leading the project through procurement and post-contract delivery.

**You'll be responsible for:**
  
• Overseeing the end-to-end project management and delivery of major new-build residential assets from concept design through pre-contract, procurement, construction, commissioning, and handover.
  
• Establishing robust project governance, controls, reporting, and decision-making processes from the early design stages.
  
• Taking ownership of the overall project programme, with particular focus on establishing, controlling and maintaining the design programme.
  
• Providing early project management oversight across the development and design functions, ensuring development objectives are translated into clear and deliverable project requirements.
  
• Coordinating with the PMC design managers and architect, design consultants, specialist consultants and wider multidisciplinary project team to ensure design deliverables are achieved against key milestones.
  
• Challenging design progress, identifying programme risks and driving consultants and stakeholders toward timely decisions and resolution.
  
• Managing the integration of design, approvals, procurement and construction programmes to maintain a clear route to delivery. This is consistent with the Mace SPM responsibility for producing and integrating design and authorities programmes with procurement and delivery programmes.
  
• Supporting and coordinating the project's residential sales launch strategy, ensuring critical design and delivery milestones support the required commercial launch dates.
  
• Supervising the fast-track delivery of the sales center, managing interfaces between design, procurement, approvals and construction to achieve an accelerated programme and then the delivery of several high-end residential apartment buildings.
  
• Developing and maintaining the project execution plan, master programme, risk register, governance structure and project reporting requirements.
  
• Managing procurement strategy and contractor appointment activities, ensuring appropriate consideration of packaging, sequencing, programme and project risk.
  
• Transitioning the project effectively from pre-contract into construction and maintaining continuity of project leadership throughout delivery.
  
• Managing consultants, contractors and specialist suppliers while driving accountability against programme, cost, quality and contractual requirements.
  
• Monitoring project performance, identifying emerging risks and implementing recovery or mitigation measures where required.
  
• Providing clear, concise reporting to senior stakeholders on programme, design, commercial matters, risks, decisions and delivery status.
  
• Maintaining stakeholder relationships and creating strong collaboration between development, design, commercial, procurement and construction teams.
  
• Maintaining strong project management discipline throughout delivery while ensuring Mace's safety, quality, and governance requirements are achieved.

**You’ll need to have:**
  
• Relevant project management and construction industry experience, with significant experience in senior project leadership positions.
  
• Demonstrable experience successfully delivering large-scale new-build residential developments of comparable size and complexity, ideally more than one major residential project.
  
• Strong evidence of managing residential projects across the complete lifecycle from early design/pre-contract through procurement, construction, and handover.
  
• Significant front-end and design management experience, with the ability to establish control of complex design programmes and drive multidisciplinary design teams against demanding milestones.
  
• Strong understanding of residential development requirements and the relationship between development strategy, design, sales and marketing milestones, procurement and physical delivery.
  
• Proven ability to manage and coordinate with architects, designers, engineering consultants, cost consultants, contractors and specialist stakeholders within complex project environments.
  
• Strong programme management skills with experience identifying programme risk, challenging consultant performance and implementing recovery strategies.
  
• Demonstrable procurement, contract, commercial, risk and change-management experience.
  
• Strong client-facing and senior stakeholder-management capability, including the confidence to operate effectively within a high-profile project subject to significant executive scrutiny.
  
• Experience delivering major projects within a PMC, client-side or development-management environment.
  
• A degree in construction management, engineering, architecture, project management or a related discipline.
  
• Professional membership such as RICS, CIOB, APM or equivalent would be advantageous, consistent with Mace's established SPM criteria.
  
• Previous experience delivering major residential developments in Saudi Arabia or the wider Middle East would be advantageous.

  

**Our values**

**Safety first - Going home safe and well:** We champion a safe, diverse and inclusive working environment, understanding the importance of wellbeing in every team.

**Client focus - Deliver on our promise:** We own the quality of deliverables, strategic outcomes and build long term relationships with our clients.

**Integrity - Always do the right thing:** We influence positive outcomes within our industry, while always aligning with our compliance obligations.

**Create opportunity - For our people to excel**: We champion a continuous improvement culture throughout all activities, inspiring our people and teams to develop.

  

Mace is an inclusive employer and welcomes interest from a diverse range of candidates. Even if you feel you do not fulfil all the criteria, please apply, as you may still be the best candidate for this role or another role within our organisation.

We are also open to discussing part-time, flexible, and hybrid working options if suitable within the role.

Title: Manager, Care Operations
Description:
**Overview**
Tonal Care runs seven days a week across an in-house Toronto team and an outsourced partner operation. The Manager, Care Operations owns how that operation performs day to day.
  
  
You will own daily delivery across all tiers, the operational relationship with our outsourced partner, and the staffing and capacity plans that keep service levels intact. You will lead a Team Lead and a team of Customer Experience Specialists, each of whom owns one or two lines of business, and you will work the queue yourself when coverage requires it.
  
  
This is a hands-on, player/coach, operating role. You set the standard, work within it, and hold the operation to it.
  
  
What You Will Do
  
  
Daily Delivery
  
  

* Act as a player-coach during the initial phase, spending dedicated time working directly in the queue alongside specialists to model best practices, coach in real time, and establish baseline workflows
* Own daily delivery across all tiers, setting service levels, coverage models, and workflow standards that hold consistent delivery across phone, email, chat, and video.
* Own the daily, weekly, and monthly plans for SLA, CSAT, Average Handle Time, and First Contact Resolution, and be accountable for hitting them.
* Identify performance trends, operational risks, and root causes, and build the action plans that close the gap.
* Lead regular performance reviews and operational business reviews with internal stakeholders and partner leadership.
* Support incident and volume management during elevated contact periods, product issues, launches, and other business disruptions.
* Work the queue yourself when coverage requires it — absences, PTO, peak volume, or an uncovered line of business. You are the final backstop on coverage.
* Translate operational data into clear insights and recommendations for Care leadership.

Outsourced Partner Performance
  
  

* Serve as the day-to-day operational point of contact for Tonal’s outsourced partner, managing performance through their team leads and supervisors.
* Hold partner leadership accountable to agreed KPIs, SLAs, quality standards, staffing commitments, and Tonal’s brand voice.
* Run weekly performance reviews with partner teams.
* Report weekly to our Logistics, Field Operations, and Care Leadership team across all Care Operations metrics.
* Partner with their leadership on performance improvement plans, staffing strategies, coaching opportunities, and operational readiness.
* Monitor partner staffing, attrition, attendance, and utilization to catch capacity risk before it reaches Members.
* Make sure partner teams are aligned to Tonal policies, workflows, and operating standards, and are prepared for new programs, product changes, and launches.
* Escalate to the Senior Manager, Care Operations when partner performance issues cannot be resolved at the working level. Contract terms, rates, and renewals sit with the Director of Care Operations.

Staffing and Capacity
  
  

* Own workforce planning with partner Workforce Management and Tonal analytics, setting capacity and staffing models against forecast demand and adjusting intraday to protect service levels.
* Plan coverage across the full seven-day operating window, including weekends, holidays, and peak periods.
* Own the volume, staffing, and partner utilization assumptions that feed Care’s operating budget.
* Monitor forecast accuracy and adjust staffing assumptions based on actual contact volume, productivity, shrinkage, and service-level performance.
* Ensure schedules keep the teams at a sustainable working load rather than at full utilization, so there is room to absorb spikes and absences.

Team Leadership
  
  

* Lead and develop the team through the Team Lead and senior specialists, owning performance calibration, coaching, career development, and coverage planning.
* Make sure every line of business has a named owner, that the assignment is understood, and that owners are held to how their domain performs.
* Be accountable for the escalations programme. Specialists and the Team Lead resolve individual escalations; you own how the programme performs and where it needs to change.
* Sit in the health, safety, and legal escalation chain: Specialist → Team Lead → Manager, Care Operations → Senior Manager, Care Operations → Director, Care Operations.
* Ensure clear ownership and communication on sensitive, complex, or high-risk Member situations.
* Monitor escalation trends to surface recurring Member pain points, and work with the frontline to reduce avoidable escalations and lift first contact resolution.

Process and Partnership
  
  

* Translate the operating plan set with the Senior Manager, Care Operations into daily execution, and own that execution.
* Work with the Care Enablement team to identify knowledge gaps and roll out new troubleshooting SOPs, training, and tool updates to the front line.
* Coordinate with Logistics and Field Operations to deliver a seamless end-to-end experience for both specialists and Members.
* Simplify workflows to reduce Member effort, improve specialist efficiency, and remove unnecessary operational friction.
* Represent Care Operations in cross-functional initiatives and launches, and support the rollout and adoption of new tools, processes, and support programs.

Coverage and Schedule
  
  
Tonal Care operates seven days a week, 9:00 AM to 10:00 PM EST. This is a hands-on leadership role and the coverage expectations come with it:
  
  

* You and your team may be required to work weekends, holidays, and after hours as coverage requires. You and your team’s schedule will shift with the needs of the operation.
* Your team will carry on-call responsibility for incidents, outages, product issues, and elevated volume periods.
* Priorities change during the day. Peak season, launches, and product escalations will change what a day looks like.

Who You Are
  
  

* You have 5+ years of experience in Customer Care, Customer Support, or Contact Center Operations, including 2+ years leading teams, vendors, or outsourced operations.
* You are operationally minded and move comfortably between the operating plan and the queue. You set the standard, then hold the operation to it.
* You have managed operational KPIs and used data to find and fix performance problems. You don’t just report numbers — you understand the why behind them and change process, staffing, or enablement to move the trend.
* You are an empathetic coach who knows how to motivate a team and can turn complex data into feedback a specialist can act on.
* You have handled complex escalations and high-impact customer situations, and you are comfortable navigating gray areas and making quick, sound decisions when they arise.
* You have strong vendor and stakeholder management skills, and can influence partners who don’t report to you.
* You are technically savvy and proficient in CRM and support tooling, with an understanding of how backend systems shape the frontline experience.
* You prioritize influence over authority, earning the trust of your team and stakeholders to drive results through collaboration rather than mandate.
* You are comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities and evolving processes.

Why You Will Love Working at Tonal
  
  

* You will own the operating model for a Care organization that is scaling across channels and lines of business
* Competitive compensation package, benefits, and Tonal product perks
* Collaborative, mission-driven team with a passion for redefining strength training

At Tonal, we believe that the unique and varied lived experiences of our teammates contribute to our overall strength. We don’t just appreciate differences, we celebrate them, and we always seek people that represent a wide variety of backgrounds. We’re dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team and designing employee experiences that contribute to your growth as much as you do to ours. If your experience aligns with what we’re looking for (even if you don’t check every single box), send us your application. We would love to hear from you!
  
  
Tonal is committed to meeting the diverse needs of people with disabilities in a timely manner that is consistent with the principles of independence, dignity, integration, and equality of opportunity. Should you have any accommodation requests, please reach out to us via our confidential email, accessibility@tonal.com. All requests will be addressed and responded to in accordance with Tonal’s Accessibility Policy and local legislation.
  
  
Compensation Range: CA$95K - CA$120K

Title: Manager, Strategic Programs and Partnerships
Description:

The Manager, Strategic Programs & Partnerships is responsible for advancing key strategic initiatives that support client experience, digital transformation, risk management, and portfolio performance within Home Financing. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Strategic Programs & Partnerships, this role supports strategic planning and portfolio management, applies data analysis to generate insights that inform decisions, manages risk and vendor outcomes, and partners with frontline and operational teams to translate strategy into scalable, compliant, and customer-centric solutions. Partnering with Operations, Risk Management, Fraud, Real Estate Secured Lending, BrokerEdge.
  
  
External Partners - Default Insurers, Title Insurance and Collateral Management partners.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Fosters a culture aligned to BMO purpose, values and strategy and role models BMO values and behaviours in all that they do.
* Ensures alignment between values and behaviour that fosters diversity and inclusion.
* Regularly connects work to BMO's purpose, sets inspirational goals, defines clear expected outcomes, and ensures clear accountability for follow through.
* Manage partner relationships, ensuring partners support BMO Home Financing policy and customer experience and deliver against contracted outcomes.
* Partner with business and operations teams to enhance end-to-end customer journeys through simplification, automation, and process redesign.
* Identify efficiencies in reporting, analytics, and operational outputs to support data-driven decision-making.
* Support the development and implementation of new partner strategic projects, coordinating with other Lines of Business as necessary.
* Lead program governance, including planning, status reporting, and decision support, and act as a 1st Line of Defence (LOD) execution leader by embedding controls, monitoring compliance, and supporting regulatory, internal and default insurer audits.
* Own the review of regulatory and policy changes, assessing impacts and supporting implementation across business units, and translating them into opportunities to reduce friction for the frontline and customers.
* Partner with Procurement, Legal, and Risk teams, and other internal stakeholders to support onboarding, renewals, and performance assessments.
* Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including Operations, Risk, Technology, Legal, and Compliance.
* Focus is primarily on business/group within BMO; may have broader, enterprise-wide focus.
* Works independently and regularly handles non-routine situations.
* Broader work or accountabilities may be assigned as needed.

* 5–7 years of relevant experience in financial services, strategic programs, operations, risk management, or transformation roles.
* Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience in data analysis and reporting, with the ability to turn data into clear insights and recommendations.
* Experience in strategic analysis, planning, and portfolio management.
* Proven ability to build and manage partnerships, including vendors and third-party relationships.
* Demonstrated experience delivering complex initiatives across multiple stakeholders.
* Working knowledge of risk, compliance, and control environments within financial services.
* Client-centric thinking.

Salaried

Title: Director of IT
Description:
Success starts at Community College of Philadelphia. Innovators and difference makers work at Community College of Philadelphia. Diversity thrives at Community College of Philadelphia. We are a college that is committed to promoting a work environment that attracts and retains talented and diverse faculty and staff. We challenge each other and ourselves to achieve at the highest level while contributing to the mission of the College and the betterment of Philadelphia. We value and support an intellectually dynamic community to prepare our students for global citizenship. Join us and become a part of a community that has long been and will continue to be generators of generational chance in this city and beyond.
  
  
Community College of Philadelphia is an open-admission, associate-degree-granting institution which provides access to higher education for all who may benefit. Its programs of study in the liberal arts and sciences, career technologies, and basic academic skills provide a coherent foundation for college transfer, employment and lifelong learning. The College serves Philadelphia by preparing its students to be informed and concerned citizens, active participants in the cultural life of the city, and enabled to meet the changing needs of business, industry and the professions. To help address broad economic, cultural and political concerns in the city and beyond, the College draws together students from a wide range of ages and backgrounds and seeks to provide the programs and support they need to achieve their goals.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Director, Information Technology Support, provides strategic and operational leadership for the planning, delivery, and continuous improvement of the College's technology infrastructure, support services, telecommunications and enterprise technology operations. In partnership with the Associate Vice President of Information Technology Services and other College leaders, the Director advances institutional goals through effective technology planning, cybersecurity governance, compliance, business continuity, vendor management and the implementation of innovative technology services and solutions. The Director leads and develops technical support staff, manages operational and capital resources, and promotes culture of collaboration, accountability, and exceptional customer service. By aligning technology services with the College's academic and administrative priorities, the Director ensures secure, reliable, and cost effective technology solutions that support student success, employee productivity, institutional effectiveness.
  
  
**Essential Responsibilities**

* Responsible for providing day-to-day planning, management, and administration of the College's Information Technology Support solutions; this includes research and development of proposed campus solutions, technical delivery, contract compliance, and effective resource management.
* Monitor and support institutional cybersecurity initiatives including risk management, vulnerability remediation, endpoint protection, access management, security awareness training, incident response and business continuity coordination efforts, and compliance with applicable regulatory requirements.
* Provide strategic oversight of cloud-based technologies, enterprise applications, collaboration platforms, and software-as-a-service solutions to ensure security, reliability, scalability, and operational effectiveness.
* Establish, monitor, and continuously improve IT service management processes, service level objectives, operational metrics, and customer experience initiatives utilizing industry best practices.
* Collaborate with institutional leadership to support compliance with applicable federal, state, and industry requirements including FERPA, GLBA, ADA accessibility standards, cybersecurity regulations, and College policies.
* Develop and monitor key performance indicators, operational dashboards, and service metrics t measure effectiveness, identify trends, and support informed decision-making.
* Evaluate emerging technologies including artificial intelligence, automation, analytics, and digital service innovations for their potential to improve institutional effectiveness, enhance IT services, and reduce operational costs.
* In collaboration with the AVP of ITS, and College management, develop and review all RFPs for the procurement of hardware and software for technology initiatives College-wide; assist in implementing the initiatives contained in the Technology Plan specific to the Technical Support Services area to enhance institutional effectiveness and cost efficiencies.
* In collaboration with the AVP of ITS assists in developing and administering ITS division processes and procedures, and disaster recovery and business continuity plans.
* Provide leadership, coordination, planning, and integrative management of the College-wide voice and data communications systems, telecommunications administration and support, and network/database administration; ensure that the voice and data infrastructure meets reliability and availability standards as stated in the College’s Technology Plan.
* In collaboration with the AVP of ITS, review, recommend, and implement policies, standards, and guidelines within the area of responsibility including classroom technology delivery and support.
* In collaboration with the AVP of ITS, develop, review and monitor contracts, consultants and relationships with Technical Support Services related vendors within the ITS division.
* Manage projects assigned by AVP of ITS by providing advice, guidance and problem-solving; coordinate with division managers, and direct and monitor the work of project teams to ensure project deliverables and timelines are met.
* Direct operations for Technical Support Services by executing production tasks according to a documented schedule that meets or exceeds customer expectations.
* Convey technology options and solution recommendations to AVP of ITS in support of ITS planning and development.
* In collaboration with the AVP of ITS and the Director of ERP, develop customer service initiatives based upon analysis of end user feedback data. Make recommendations for continuous improvement.
* In collaboration with the AVP of ITS, develop and manage operating and capital budget related to Technical Support services to support goals, functions, programs, and services.
* Coordinate with the College purchasing department on technology procurements; oversee lease replacement and maintenance schedules for asset management; monitor contracts, consultants, and relationships with vendors as related to Technical Support services.
* Provide strategic leadership, coaching, mentoring, accountability, and professional development opportunities for assigned staff while fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, customer service excellence, continuous improvement, and operational effectiveness.
* In collaboration with the AVP of ITS, participate in the selection, evaluation and discipline of subordinate staff; establish and assign staff workload and projects, develop and monitor performance standards, conduct training and evaluate performance.
* In collaboration with the AVP of ITS, monitor new technologies and assess their potential for solving College-wide initiatives and/or delivery of new services.
* Deliver quality customer services to both internal and external constituents in a professional, helpful, and courteous manner.
* Participate in college-wide committees as directed by the AVP of ITS.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree required in Information Technology, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Business Administration, or related field. Master's degree preferred.
* Minimum seven (7) years of progressively responsible information technology leadership experience.
* Minimum five (5) years of supervisory or management experience leading technical teams.
* Experience in higher education, public sector, or similarly complex organizations preferred.
* Experience managing enterprise infrastructure, cloud technologies, cybersecurity programs, technology support, ITSM services, and vendor relationships preferred.
* Demonstrated knowledge and experience in creating and monitoring formal project plans required.
* Required skills and certifications: Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert, CCNA or equivalent
* The ability to meet deadlines and manage multiple and changing priorities in a fast-paced environment is required.
* Demonstrated ability to exercise good judgment in evaluating situations and making assessments for required decisions.
* Strong orientation to planning, customer service, assertive decision-making, and reconciling conflicting needs is required.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills and the ability to manage a full scope of services in a unionized environment are required.
* Demonstrated experience in dealing with issues that affect operations, policy, funding, and budgets in a mid-to-large organization is required.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze, design, test, implement, and document complex solutions for assigned clients and/or systems is required.
* Ability to maintain sensitivity, understanding, and respect for a diverse academic environment, inclusive of students, faculty, and staff of varying social, economic, cultural, ideological, and ethnic backgrounds is required.

**Preferred Qualifications**
Relevant professional certifications in cybersecurity, governance, project management, IT service management, collaboration technologies, cloud communications, infrastructure, networking, and enterprise architecture are highly preferred. Examples include CISSP, CISM, CGEIT, CRISC, PMP, CAPM, Agile, ITIL, Microsoft Teams Administrator, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, and CCNP Enterprise.

Title: Deputy Director of Communications
Description:
**About the Organization:**

The Office of Consumer Affairs and Business Regulation (OCABR) is a state agency within the Executive Office of Economic Development and is responsible for protecting consumers through advocacy and education. The Office of Consumer Affairs works to ensure that the businesses our agencies regulate treat all Massachusetts consumers fairly. The Division of Banks ("DOB"), Division of Insurance ("DOI"), Division of Occupational Licensure ("DOL"), Division of Standards ("DOS"), and Department of Telecommunications and Cable ("DTC") all fall under the OCABR umbrella and help us to fulfill our critical mission of building better businesses and smarter consumers.

The Office of Consumer Affairs and Business Regulation is committed to creating and sustaining a work culture that is welcoming, inclusive, and mutually respectful to all its employees regardless of race, color, age, creed, religion, national origin, ethnicity, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, veteran or disability status. We strive to reflect diversity in all facets and levels of our agency. The Office or Consumer Affairs and Business Regulation values inclusiveness and diversity within their employee and management teams. Within our community we strive to create and maintain working and learning environments that are inclusive, equitable, and welcoming.

The Office of Consumer Affairs and Business Regulation is committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace where all employees feel respected, valued, and empowered to maximize their skills and talents to serve our citizens.

**About the Role:**

The Deputy Director of Communications serves in a senior strategic communications and policy advisory capacity within the Office of Consumer Affairs and Business Regulation, providing leadership in the formulation, development, evaluation, and implementation of agency-wide communications policies, strategic initiatives, and organizational priorities across OCABR and its five component agencies. Working in close collaboration with the Director of Communications, Undersecretary, Deputy Undersecretary, and agency leadership, the Deputy Director exercises substantial independent judgment and participates meaningfully in executive-level policy development and strategic decision-making to advance the mission and priorities of OCABR, the Executive Office, and the Governor's Office.

The Deputy Director participates substantially in the development and evaluation of agency policies, strategic goals, and major program initiatives, providing substantive analysis and recommendations that inform executive leadership decisions. The position independently evaluates proposed policies and initiatives, identifies communications implications, public engagement considerations, and potential policy concerns, and recommends modifications that support agency objectives and organizational priorities. The Deputy Director represents the communications function in executive-level policy discussions and serves as a strategic advisor to senior leadership on matters involving public policy, regulatory initiatives, consumer protection, licensing programs, legislative developments, and other issues affecting OCABR and its component agencies.

The Deputy Director develops and directs comprehensive communications strategies and initiatives, including media relations, digital communications, agency websites, social media, public information campaigns, executive messaging, visual communications, and performance evaluation. The position exercises independent judgment in establishing communications priorities, developing messaging strategies, and advising executive leadership on sensitive or high-profile matters. Responsibilities include directing the development and review of official agency communications, executive briefings, policy statements, speeches, talking points, press releases, consumer alerts, public guidance, and educational materials to ensure consistency with agency policies, strategic objectives, and applicable statutory and regulatory requirements.

The position manages and coordinates communications efforts including the OCABR and agency websites, social media accounts, media inquiries, press outreach, educational content, videos, event presentations, and executive briefing materials.

The Deputy Director assists with the annual communications plan, supports leadership and agencies with consumer alerts, guidance, and policy briefs, and helps manage all internal and public communications related to policies, regulations, legislative matters, legal issues, consumer protection and licensing programs, visual communication, and branding.

The Deputy Director provides strategic oversight of media relations activities and coordinates responses to complex or sensitive press inquiries and public records requests in consultation with OCABR leadership, legal counsel, and designated records custodians. The position evaluates communications risks, recommends appropriate agency responses, and advises executive leadership on matters affecting public messaging and agency policy. In coordination with legal counsel and appropriate program personnel, the Deputy Director reviews sensitive information and provides recommendations concerning disclosure considerations and potential redactions, consistent with applicable public records laws and agency procedures.

The Deputy Director develops and directs strategic public engagement and outreach initiatives in collaboration with the Community Outreach Supervisor, Director of Communications, and agency leadership. The position participates in establishing outreach priorities, developing stakeholder engagement strategies, and directing communications activities associated with executive events, public forums, webinars, and other agency initiatives. The Deputy Director advises executive leadership on opportunities to advance agency policy objectives through public engagement and evaluates the effectiveness of outreach strategies to recommend improvements to agency-wide communications and engagement priorities.

The Deputy Director, working with Community Outreach Supervisor, additionally advises on community outreach planning and execution and the preparation of all materials used in community outreach activities; the Deputy Director will regularly attend community outreach events and coordinate participation of agencies comprising the Office.

The Deputy Director serves as the designated acting representative for the Director of Communications when assigned, assuming delegated strategic, operational, and decision-making responsibilities necessary to maintain continuity of the communications function. The position provides direction and oversight to communications co-ops and interns, including assigning work, establishing priorities, monitoring performance, and coordinating daily activities, consistent with delegated supervisory authority. In carrying out these responsibilities, the Deputy Director routinely handles sensitive, privileged, or otherwise protected information and exercises discretion in safeguarding such materials in accordance with applicable laws and agency policies.

The Deputy Director performs other related duties as assigned, consistent with the position's responsibilities and delegated authority.

We are seeking an experiencedProgram Manager, Renewable Energy Programs to oversee a portfolio of complex, multi-year capital projects that support fleet electrification, facility decarbonization, renewable energy implementation, and sustainable transit infrastructure.

  

This role is responsible for leading the planning, delivery, and governance of large-scale programs involving battery-electric bus infrastructure, Wheel-Trans electrification, charging systems, energy storage, solar power, and facility modernization initiatives. Working with internal teams, consultants, utility providers, government partners, and contractors, you will drive projects from concept through commissioning while ensuring alignment with TTC's operational needs, capital priorities, climate commitments, and funding requirements.

Responsible for building credibility, establishing rapport and maintaining communication with stakeholders at multiple levels, including those external to the organization.

  

As a senior-level practitioner at the forefront of advancing the Department’s and TTC’s strategic goals and objectives, the Project Manager leads integrated TTC and consultant project teams. These teams are responsible for the coordination, implementation and management of multi-year, multi-discipline capital projects, and programs from inception, planning, design, procurement and production through safety certification, commissioning, and project close-out. Projects will include the electrification of both TTC fleet and facilities. This includes the electrification of the conventional bus, wheel-trans bus and non-revenue fleets as well as the decarbonization of facilities and implementation of renewable energy; all of which are large scale in nature and/or highly complex.

Join the TTC's Engineering, Construction & Expansion (ECE) Project Management Office and play a critical leadership role in overseeing cost, schedule, change management, performance reporting, and project controls governance across a multi-billion-dollar capital program portfolio.

This is a unique opportunity to lead a team of project controls professionals supporting more than 600 capital projects while helping shape the future of project delivery through the implementation of enterprise-wide project controls systems, reporting frameworks, and performance management practices.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

As the Manager, Project Controls, you will provide leadership and oversight for integrated project controls functions across the ECE capital portfolio, ensuring consistent application of project controls standards, processes, systems, and governance requirements. Reporting to the Director, Project Controls & Risk, you will lead a multidisciplinary team responsible for scheduling, cost management, change management, performance management, and project reporting activities across a diverse portfolio of transit infrastructure projects.

  

You will oversee the development and maintenance of project and program baselines and ensure that cost, schedule, estimating, and risk management inputs are effectively integrated into portfolio planning and forecasting activities. Working closely with project teams, risk management, estimating, scheduling, and finance stakeholders, you will establish and maintain cost and schedule baselines, forecasts, performance metrics, contingency allocations, and Earned Value Management reporting.

  

The successful incumbent will direct budget set-up, cost management, commitments, accruals, forecasting, funding tracking, and variance analysis across the portfolio. You will ensure project teams have access to accurate, timely, and reliable project performance information to support effective decision-making, financial stewardship, and delivery accountability.

  

You will lead portfolio-wide change management and change control activities, coordinating review processes, governance meetings, approvals, and the tracking of changes that impact cost, schedule, scope, funding, and project objectives. You will work closely with Project Directors, Senior Project Managers, and senior leadership to evaluate impacts and support informed decision-making across the portfolio.

  

A key component of this role will be leading performance management and reporting functions by maintaining centralized project controls systems, monitoring cost and schedule performance trends, analyzing variances, tracking earned value performance, and identifying emerging risks and opportunities.

  

You will oversee the preparation of executive-level reports, dashboards, portfolio summaries, and decision-support materials for senior leadership and corporate stakeholders.

  

You will champion the successful adoption of the Enterprise Project Controls Management System (Ares PRISM), helping establish a single source of truth for project baselines, cost control, forecasting, performance measurement, and change management activities across the portfolio.

  

Through strong leadership, stakeholder engagement, and process improvement, you will drive consistency, transparency, and accountability across project delivery teams.

  

As a people leader, you will build, mentor, develop, and inspire a high-performing team of project controls professionals.

  

You will foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment while ensuring your team remains focused on delivering value, identifying performance trends, and proactively supporting successful project outcomes.

  

Your ability to think strategically while also being willing to "zoom in" on project-level challenges will be critical to success in this role.

Title: Director, Grid Operations
Description:
**Lead the operation of a large and complex distribution grid while shaping how it will operate tomorrow.**

  

As Director, Grid Operations, you will be accountable for the safe, reliable and resilient operation of Toronto’s electrical distribution system, 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, serving the customers and communities who depend on it. Reporting to the VP, Distribution Operations, you will lead the control room, dispatch, emergency response and operational technology teams that keep the lights on and enable the delivery of Toronto Hydro’s capital and maintenance programs.

  

You will also lead the development and implementation of modernization strategies for the tools, systems and processes at the heart of grid operations, enabling better real-time decision-making and a safer, more reliable and resilient grid. Working closely with internal business units, external partners, Hydro One and the IESO, this is a senior leadership role where day-to-day reliability meets long-term grid modernization.

  

*This posting is for an existing vacancy.*

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

  

* Accountable for the safe, reliable and resilient operation of the distribution system 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.
* Builds strong relationships and coordinates with Hydro One, the Independent Electricity System Operator (IESO), perimeter utilities, other agencies and large customers.
* Sets the direction for real-time work management to enable effective event response and the efficient delivery of construction, maintenance and commissioning activities.
* Directs emergency grid response and restoration, serving as the senior escalation point during system disturbances and strengthening readiness for extreme weather and other events that test system resilience.
* Sets the strategy to modernize and continuously improve the core operational tools, systems and platforms critical to the control and operation of the grid.
* Drives the adoption of advanced grid control, operational technology and analytics capabilities, partnering with technology and cybersecurity teams to strengthen the security and resilience of operational systems.
* Advances a human and organizational performance (HOP) approach to safety by designing work and controls that anticipate human error, learning from events and everyday work, and equipping leaders to own safety outcomes across planned and emergency work.
* Builds and develops a strong leadership, technical and field talent pipeline through coaching, performance management, succession and development, while engaging employees in achieving corporate and departmental goals.
* Fosters a high-performance culture rooted in respect, curiosity, learning and accountability.
* Owns operating and capital budgets and departmental performance, driving improvement across people, financial, operational and customer measures and overseeing outsourced service agreements to achieve established performance expectations.
* Ensures compliance with regulatory, quality and operating standards through effective governance, policies, procedures and operational controls.
* Represents Toronto Hydro with industry partners and associations, building relationships and influencing practices that support effective distribution operations.

  

**REQUIREMENTS:**

  

* Undergraduate degree in Engineering, Business, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* Seven (7) or more years of progressive leadership experience, including experience leading leaders and managing operating and capital budgets.
* Ten (10) or more years of experience in utility operations, including areas such as control centre operations, trouble dispatch/response, and distribution construction and maintenance.
* Strong knowledge of electrical distribution operations, control room operations, emergency management, work execution practices, and 24/7 work management for both response and planned work.
* Demonstrated knowledge of applicable safe work practices, procedures and requirements, including the Utility Work Protection Code and risk management principles.
* Knowledge of distribution operations systems and platforms and how electrical distribution systems are configured and operated, including radial, loop and secondary mesh networks.
* Strong financial and business acumen, with demonstrated project management capability.
* Strategic thinking and strong written and verbal communication, stakeholder engagement and change management skills.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, including the ability to exercise sound judgment and maintain composure under pressure.

Title: Collections Manager
Description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

### **Position Summary**

Harness is seeking a Collections Manager to own accounts receivable and cash collections for our fast-growing SaaS business, as part of the Revenue Accounting team. This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who drives cash in, reduces days sales outstanding, and builds the collections infrastructure to scale with the business.

The ideal candidate is an operator who works independently, maintains audit-ready processes, and acts as the go-to expert and escalation point for collections across Finance, Sales, Legal, and DealOps. You will partner closely with the billing team to keep invoicing accurate, but your focus is the full collections lifecycle: from credit review through cash application, dispute resolution, and reporting.

### **About the role**

**Collections & AR Lifecycle Management**

* End-to-end ownership: Own the AR aging cycle across the customer base; monitor outstanding balances, prioritize outreach, and drive timely collection of past-due accounts.
* Strategic collections: Develop tailored collection strategies for key and high-risk accounts, including executive-level escalations and payment plan negotiations.
* Forecasting: Partner with Finance to forecast cash receipts and flag collection risk, reserves, and write-off candidates ahead of period close.
* Escalation and mentorship: Serve as the escalation point and subject matter expert for collections; coach team members on best practices and set outreach cadences and standards.

**Cash Application & Reconciliation**

* Manage the end-to-end cash application process, ensuring timely and accurate posting of bank deposits, wire transfers, ACH, and credit card payments to the subledger.
* Reconcile unapplied cash and clear exceptions, working with Treasury and Accounting to keep the AR subledger tied to the general ledger.

**Credit Risk Assessment**

* Perform credit reviews for new customers and establish and monitor credit limits to mitigate financial risk.
* Identify accounts with deteriorating payment behavior and recommend holds, terms changes, or other risk actions.

**Dispute & Deduction Management**

* Resolve payment disputes, credit memos, and refund requests within defined SLAs.
* Partner with Legal and DealOps on complex contract interpretations, and with Sales on customer relationship strategy for sensitive accounts.
* Track root causes of disputes and feed them back to billing and sales operations to prevent repeat issues.

**Metrics & Reporting**

* Develop and maintain AR dashboards that track KPIs including DSO, collection effectiveness index, past-due percentage, aging trends, and unapplied cash.
* Provide regular reporting and insights on collections performance to Revenue Accounting and Finance leadership.

**Billing Partnership & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work with the billing team to resolve invoice errors, contract mismatches, and amendments that delay payment; escalate systemic billing issues with the right context and urgency.
* Build strong partnerships with DealOps, Sales, Legal, IT, and Finance, and communicate clearly with leadership on collections risk and cash performance.
* Maintain working knowledge of NetSuite and Salesforce-to-NetSuite data flows as they relate to invoicing, payment terms, and customer records.

**Process Optimization & Continuous Improvement**

* Analyze collections and cash application workflows to find bottlenecks, and implement scalable, automated solutions that reduce manual effort.
* Lead initiatives with IT and Sales Operations to streamline the quote-to-cash process, including dunning, payment reminders, and customer self-service payment options.
* Create and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) for all collections, cash application, and credit tasks, and keep them current as processes evolve.

**Month-End Close & Compliance**

* Complete all collections and AR tasks on schedule, including journal entries for adjustments, reserves, and write-offs, and support flux analysis on AR balances.
* Maintain audit-ready documentation and support external audit requests, including PBC samples and process walkthroughs.
* Ensure collections practices comply with ASC 606, SOX controls, and internal credit and revenue recognition policies.

### **About You**

* 5–7 years of collections, accounts receivable, or revenue accounting experience in a high-growth SaaS or software company, with a proven record of reducing DSO and past-due balances.
* Experience owning collections strategy for enterprise B2B accounts, including negotiating with customer finance and procurement teams and handling executive escalations.
* Strong working experience with NetSuite (AR, cash application, and customer records) and Salesforce-to-NetSuite data flows.
* Advanced Excel/Sheets skills, including XLOOKUP, pivot tables, and managing large data sets for reconciliation and aging analysis.
* Demonstrated experience identifying process gaps and implementing workflow improvements or automation.
* Strong cross-functional communication skills; comfortable engaging with Sales, Legal, and Finance leadership.
* Ability to work independently, prioritize competing demands, and guide or mentor others.

**Preferred**

* Experience with usage-based or consumption billing models.
* Exposure to a SOX controls environment and internal audit processes at publicly traded companies.
* Experience with credit risk assessment and credit limit management for B2B customers.
* Experience with collections automation or AR tools and building AR dashboards.

* Flexible work schedule

Title: Senior Project Manager / Project Director – Supervision
Description:
**Job Description**
What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?
  
  
At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced and delivery-focused Senior Project Manager / Project Director – Supervision to lead the day-to-day management and successful delivery of major Property & Buildings supervision projects across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
  
  
The role will be responsible for project leadership, client management, supervision operations, commercial performance, bid support, project governance, and multidisciplinary team coordination. Working closely with the Project Director and Director of Supervision, the successful candidate will ensure projects are delivered safely, efficiently, profitably, and in accordance with WSP's quality standards and client expectations.
  
  
The role requires strong leadership, client-facing capabilities, operational management, and commercial acumen, ensuring successful project outcomes and long-term client satisfaction.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Project Leadership & Delivery**

* Lead the delivery of major supervision projects from mobilisation through to completion.
* Manage multidisciplinary supervision teams to ensure projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and to the required quality standards.
* Develop and maintain project execution plans, resource plans, and delivery strategies.
* Monitor project progress, project risks, and key performance indicators.
* Ensure effective coordination between clients, contractors, consultants, authorities, and project stakeholders.
* Lead project review meetings and ensure proactive resolution of delivery issues.
* Support project close-out, handover, and lessons learned activities.

**Client Relationship Management**

* Act as the primary client contact for assigned projects.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, developers, contractors, and government authorities.
* Ensure client expectations are understood and consistently achieved.
* Drive high levels of client satisfaction and repeat business opportunities.
* Participate in client presentations, project reviews, and progress meetings.
* Support account development within existing client portfolios.

**Supervision Operations**

* Manage the operational delivery of supervision services across assigned projects.
* Ensure appropriate deployment and utilisation of project resources.
* Coordinate Resident Engineers, discipline leads, inspectors, and specialist teams.
* Monitor workforce requirements and resource planning.
* Promote consistency in project controls, reporting, and supervision practices.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives across project delivery.

**Commercial Management**

* Manage project budgets, revenue, resource utilisation, and profitability.
* Monitor project financial performance and forecasting.
* Identify commercial risks and opportunities and implement mitigation measures.
* Support contract administration, variation management, and change control processes.
* Ensure compliance with contractual obligations and project governance requirements.
* Assist with claims management and commercial discussions where required.

**Bid & Business Development Support**

* Support proposal preparation, technical submissions, and tender responses.
* Participate in client interviews and project presentations.
* Contribute project delivery expertise to work-winning activities.
* Support opportunity identification within existing projects and client accounts.
* Assist with pipeline development and pursuit activities within KSA.

**Governance, Risk & Quality**

* Ensure compliance with WSP project management systems and governance requirements.
* Maintain oversight of project risk registers and mitigation plans.
* Drive quality assurance and quality control across project delivery.
* Monitor project compliance with contractual, regulatory, and authority requirements.
* Ensure lessons learned and best practices are captured and implemented across projects.
* Promote a strong culture of accountability, quality, and continuous improvement.

**Health, Safety & Environment**

* Champion WSP's safety-first culture across all project activities.
* Ensure compliance with health, safety, environmental, and quality standards.
* Monitor project HSE performance and ensure corrective actions are implemented where required.
* Support the development of a proactive safety culture across project teams.

**People Leadership**

* Lead, mentor, and develop project teams.
* Support performance management, coaching, and capability development.
* Foster collaboration, teamwork, and high-performance behaviours.
* Support graduate and junior staff development.
* Promote WSP's values, culture, and professional standards.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, or related discipline.
* Master's Degree desirable.
* PMP or equivalent project management qualification preferred.
* PE, CEng, or equivalent professional accreditation is advantageous.
* 20+ years of project management and construction supervision experience.
* Proven track record managing large-scale building projects within Saudi Arabia or the Middle East.
* Experience managing multidisciplinary supervision teams and major client relationships.
* Strong understanding of project governance, contract administration, and commercial management.

Why Join WSP?
  
  
At WSP, you will be part of one of the world's leading professional services firms, delivering some of Saudi Arabia's most significant and transformative developments. You will have the opportunity to lead complex projects, work with major clients, develop high-performing teams, and contribute to shaping the built environment across the Kingdom.

Title: Senior Delivery Manager

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

* Demonstrated ability to manage complex delivery plans, dependencies, and risks
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
* Analytical and data-driven approach to decision-making
* Exposure to enterprise delivery frameworks and governance models
* PMP, ACP, or equivalent certification preferred

Title: Banking Partnerships & Quality Director
Description:
**ADP is hiring a Banking Partnerships & Quality Director**

The Director, Bank Partnerships, Analytics and Quality is an individual and senior leadership role within Payments Operations responsible for strengthening and managing strategic relationships with Banking Partners while delivering data-driven insights that support business growth, operational excellence and quality framework required to operate a high-performing payments organization and client satisfaction.

This role serves as the primary liaison between Payment Operations and its banking partners, ensuring relationships are proactively managed, service expectations are clearly defined, performance is measured, issues are escalated appropriately, and opportunities for improvement are identified and delivered. The Director leverages data analytics and business intelligence to identify trends, opportunities, risks, and performance improvements across payment operations and partner performance.

The Director will work to create consistent standards, measurements, reporting and governance across payment processes. The role will translate operational data into actionable insights and establish quality standards that enable the organization to improve service, reduce risk, increase efficiency and support business growth.

The successful candidate will combine relationship management expertise, financial services knowledge, and analytical leadership to influence business decisions and strengthen strategic partnerships.

Ready to #MakeYourMark?**Apply now!**

**What you’ll do:**

Own the operational relationship with key banking and financial institution partners supporting the company’s payment ecosystem.

* Develop and maintain executive-level relationships with banking partners.

* Ensure partner activities align with regulatory requirements and internal policies.
* Monitor operational, financial, and reputational risks related to banking partnerships.
* Support audits, regulatory reviews, and compliance assessments involving banking partners.
* Partner with Risk and Compliance teams to mitigate emerging risks.

**Leadership**

* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Lead cross-functional initiatives involving Operations, Product, Risk, Compliance, Technology, and Finance teams.
* Present recommendations and business insights to executive leadership.

* 10+ years of progressive experience within financial services, payments, banking, fintech or a related operational environment.
* 5+ years managing strategic client or bank partner relationships.
* Experience working with payment systems, payroll, ACH/EFT, wire payments, or treasury operations.
* Demonstrated experience leveraging data analytics to influence business decisions.
* Experience presenting to executive leadership and external stakeholders.
* Experience developing operational analytics, dashboards and executive reporting.
* Experience establishing operational KPIs, SLAs, quality standards and performance-management frameworks.
* Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional initiatives involving Operations, Product, Technology, Risk and Compliance.

**Technical Skills:**

* Strong understanding of payment processing, banking operations and the Canadian payments ecosystem.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Advanced proficiency with Excel, Power BI, Tableau, SQL, or similar analytical tools.
* Strong understanding of operational risk, controls and quality management.
* Experience developing KPIs, dashboards, and executive reporting.
* Understanding of payment processing, risk management, and banking operations.
* Strong negotiation, influencing and stakeholder-management capabilities.
* Ability to establish structure and standards in a developing or evolving organization.

**Leadership Competencies**

* Strategic thinking – connects operational performance to business strategy and growth.
* External leadership – builds trusted relationships with banking and strategic partners.
* Data-driven leadership – uses analytics to identify trends, risks and opportunities.
* Operational excellence – establishes measurable standards and drives continuous improvement.
* Influence – brings together stakeholders across Operations, Product, Technology, Risk and Compliance.
* Executive presence – communicates clearly with senior leaders and external executives.
* Accountability – establishes ownership, transparency and follow-through.
* Change leadership – creates structure and standards in a changing payment.

**Success Metrics**

**The Director will be measured on:**

* Banking partner satisfaction and relationship health.
* Achievement of partner service level agreements.
* Operational performance improvement.
* Reduction in payment exceptions and operational risks.
* Delivery of actionable business insights.
* Executive stakeholder satisfaction.
* Cost optimization initiatives.
* Successful implementation of strategic partner initiatives starting with Unit of Work.

* MBA or advanced degree considered an asset.
