Title: Vice President, People & Culture Operations, Middle East, Africa & Turkiye
Description:
**Company Description**

Accor is a world leader in the hotel industry, present in 110 countries, with more than 5,500 hotels and 10,000 restaurants and bars. The group deploys an integrated hotel ecosystem that is among the most diversified in the sector, notably associating luxury and high-end brands, mid-range and economic offers, exclusive lifestyle concepts, venues for shows and entertainment, clubs, restaurants and bars, private residences, shared accommodation, Qantas Lounges, concierge services and co-working spaces. Accor has a portfolio of incomparable brands, led by more than 300,000 employees around the world.

 **Job Description**

Every exceptional guest experience begins with an exceptional people experience. As Vice President, People & Culture Operations, Middle East, Africa & Turkiye, you will shape how more than 250 managed and franchised hotels, in one of Accor’s most dynamic regions, attract, grow and keep the talent behind them.

Based in Dubai, reporting to the SVP People & Culture MEA APAC and sitting on the Middle East, Africa and Turkiye Executive Committee, this role serves as a commercially driven People & Culture partner to regional and hotel leaders. You will bring sound judgement, a strong working knowledge of employment law, and proven experience in compliance and in employee and industrial relations across markets with very different rules.

Capability is where you will make your mark. As Accor Academy’s champion across the region, you will make it the engine of how our Heartists learn, grow and lead to build the next generation of hotel leaders and a pipeline of talent ready for the region’s growth.

You will unite the regional People & Culture community behind a shared agenda and hold it to delivery, while building a commercial People & Culture offer for our franchise partners. Together, this will turn stronger engagement, retention and capability into what counts most: the guest experience and business performance.

**What You Will Be Responsible For**

*Business Partnership & Operational Performance*

* As a member of the Middle East, Africa and Turkiye Executive Committee, partner with the Regional President, Middle East, Africa & Turkiye, to translate business priorities into people strategies that deliver measurable operational and commercial outcomes.
* Act as a trusted adviser to General Managers and Operations leaders, providing guidance, coaching and challenge on workforce planning, leadership and organisational effectiveness.
* Use workforce and operational insights to identify risks and opportunities, strengthen leadership accountability and connect engagement and capability with guest experience, productivity and business performance.

*Capability, Talent & Employee Experience*

* Champion Accor Academy as the centrepiece of the region’s capability agenda. Mobilise hotel leaders and the P&C community to make continuous learning part of everyday operations, turning capability into career growth, stronger leadership and measurable business performance.
* Partner with Accor Academy, Talent Experience teams and hotel leaders on workforce planning, attraction and retention. Build succession pipelines and promote internal mobility across brands, hotels and geographies.
* Turn employee feedback into action on engagement and well-being, improving the Heartist experience while strengthening retention, service excellence and productivity.
* Lead inclusion and social impact across the region. Embed inclusive practices in how we hire, develop and promote, and champion causes that create positive outcomes for Heartists and the communities we serve.
* Lead the regional People & Culture community to share expertise, build capability and deliver common priorities.

*Employee Relations, Compliance & Governance*

* Lead complex employee relations (ER), industrial relations (IR) and workplace investigations, ensuring fair, consistent and timely handling of sensitive matters.
* Apply a strong working knowledge of local employment and labour law to guide decisions and ensure compliance with legislation, company policies and governance requirements.
* Partner with Legal and regional stakeholders to manage people-related risks, and equip hotel P&C teams to uphold sound practice across diverse markets.

*People Analytics, Insights & Systems*

* Drive adoption of Group People & Culture systems, tools and services across the region, embedding consistent processes and clear service standards for hotel teams.
* Strengthen data quality and use workforce, talent and operational insights to guide decisions. Track retention, succession readiness, engagement, learning adoption and workforce effectiveness, turning insight into action and accountability for results.

  
**Qualifications**

**What We’re Looking For**

* 10+ years of progressive People & Culture leadership experience, including responsibility for large, multi-site operations.
* A track record as a partner to senior operational leaders and executives, delivering measurable business and employee outcomes.
* Experience embedding continuous learning and capability building across complex organisations, connecting development with operational performance.
* Strong expertise in talent, succession, workforce planning, organisational development and leadership development.
* A strong working knowledge of employment and labour law, with proven experience in compliance, workplace investigations, and employee and industrial relations across Middle East and African markets.
* Commercial acumen to package, position and sell people services to owners or clients, ideally in a franchise context.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn workforce insights into practical business action.
* Experience working in global, multicultural environments.
* The credibility, communication and influencing skills to mobilise regional P&C teams and engage senior stakeholders and owners.
* A commitment to hospitality, well-being, inclusion and social impact, with a track record of advancing inclusion that strengthens talent pipelines.

  
**Additional Information**

**Why Join Accor?**  
Make an impact at scale. Take a seat on the Middle East, Africa & Turkiye Executive Committee and shape the people agenda for more than 250 hotels in one of Accor’s most dynamic regions.

Lead the growth of Accor Academy across the region, build the next generation of hotel leaders, and turn People & Culture into a commercial offer for our franchise partners.

In return, you’ll enjoy:

* Global career opportunities across Accor’s international network.
* Discounted Heartist® rates at Accor hotels, restaurants and wellness destinations worldwide.
* Access to industry-leading learning, development and leadership programmes.

If you are a commercial partner to senior leaders, know how to build capability at scale, and bring deep ER/IR expertise across diverse markets, we’d love to hear from you.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Team Summary:
  
  
Client Services provides industry-leading operational support to Visa’s clients around the world. Title: Delivery Manager, Wealth Management
Description:
Requisition ID: 278377
  
  
Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

  

**The role:**

  

The Delivery Manager supports the planning, coordination, and delivery of projects within the Enterprise Delivery Office (EDO) Wealth Management portfolio. This role is primarily focused on strong project coordination, financial management, reporting, and stakeholder support, while progressively building delivery management capabilities such as integrated planning, risk and issue management, and governance under the guidance of senior delivery leaders.

  
  
  

**What will you do?**

  

**Project Leadership & Support**

* Build strong partnerships with Business Sponsors, Technology teams, and delivery partners
* Collaborate across teams to ensure business outcomes and delivery objectives are achieved
* Support coordination across internal teams and external vendors
* Strong organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills
* Contribute to continuous improvement of delivery standards, tools, and ways of working

**Role Dimensions:**

* Wealth Management technology and change initiatives within ScotiaTech
* Enterprise programs supporting multi-region stakeholders
* Cross-functional collaboration across Technology, Business, Risk, Finance, and Operations
* Project budgets typically up to ~$20MM
* Vendor and consulting spend support
* Oversight of multiple workstreams
* Delivery of technology modernization and transformation initiatives
* Adherence to enterprise governance, audit, and regulatory controls

* Analytical and data-driven approach to decision-making

Technical Operations Manager

A newly established automotive sales company in Canada is preparing to launch and expand its presence in the local market. As part of its growth strategy, the company is building a strong local team to support its operations and deliver high-quality customer experiences.

About the Role

We are seeking a strategic and hands-on
**Technical Operations Manager**

Title: Senior Manager, Continuous Improvement, Ecomm Operations

**Why is this role important?**

At Loblaw Digital, we know our customers expect the best from us. Whether that means building innovative online shopping experiences or finding new ways to get customers what they want, when and where they want it, we’re up for the challenge. We’ve created leading e-commerce experiences across grocery, beauty, pharmacy, and apparel—and we’re only just getting started.

The PC Express Operations team leads all systems from connecting customer order demand through to in- store execution and post purchase activities. At Loblaw Digital, we seek great people to continually strengthen our culture. We believe great people model our values, are authentic, build trust and make connections.

Title: Senior Project Manager
Description:

The Toronto Transit Commission (TTC), North America's third largest transit system and recognized as one of the top places to work in the GTA has introduced its new 2024-2028 TTC Corporate Plan - Moving Toronto, Connecting Communities which continues the TTC’s legacy of delivering service to hundreds of millions of customers a year. The TTC’s new vision and mission statements also help promote the many environmental, social equity and economic benefits that the TTC provides:

  

**Vision:** Moving Toronto towards a more equitable, sustainable, and prosperous future.

  

**Mission:** To serve the needs of transit riders by providing a safe, reliable, efficient, and accessible mass public transit service through a seamless integrated network to create access to opportunity for everyone.

  

**POSITION OVERVIEW**
---------------------

The Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) is seeking an experienced and strategic project management leader to lead the delivery of major electrification infrastructure initiatives within its Renewable Energy Programs portfolio. A key focus of the role will be the strategic planning and implementation of charging systems and associated electrical infrastructure supporting the TTC's transition to a zero-emission fleet, including utility coordination, energization, facility integration, commissioning and operational readiness.

  

Reporting to the Head, Renewable Energy Programs, the Senior Project Manager will provide strategic leadership across multidisciplinary teams and oversee complex, multi-year capital initiatives from planning and procurement through design, construction, installation, energization, testing, commissioning and transition to operations. The role is accountable for managing critical technical, commercial and operational interfaces and aligning infrastructure deployment with fleet requirements, facility constraints, electrical capacity and program milestones.

  

The role will also contribute to the advancement of the TTC's broader renewable energy and sustainability portfolio, which may include emerging technologies and future renewable energy opportunities. The successful candidate will combine strategic program leadership with strong infrastructure delivery experience, balancing technical, commercial and operational requirements while providing governance, risk, stakeholder and change management leadership to achieve desired business outcomes.

**SCOPE & RESPONSIBILITIES**
----------------------------

The duties of this role will include but are not limited to the below:

  

Strategic Portfolio, Program Delivery & Operational Readiness

* Lead complex electrification, charging infrastructure and related capital programs, while supporting the advancement of broader renewable energy, sustainability and emerging technology initiatives within the Renewable Energy Programs portfolio.
* Develop and lead implementation strategies for charging systems and associated electrical infrastructure, including deployment sequencing, facility integration, electrical capacity and utility requirements, energization, testing, commissioning and alignment with fleet deployment and operational needs.
* Provide strategic oversight of critical interfaces among utilities, engineering teams, contractors, technology suppliers, facilities, fleet and operations, proactively managing infrastructure, energization, schedule and operational dependencies.
* Lead Project Managers, Program Managers, engineers, consultants, contractors and cross-functional teams through all phases of project and program delivery.
* Translate long-term program objectives into executable delivery roadmaps, including governance, procurement and commercial approaches, key decision points, resource requirements, risk mitigation and performance measures.
* Strengthen project management maturity through effective governance, standards, audit and assurance action plans, and continuous improvement.
* Oversee operational readiness, stakeholder impact assessments, change management, communications, training, and transition planning.

  

Contract, Commercial, Financial & Risk Management

* Lead and/or support the development and oversight of capital budgets, forecasts, resource plans, business cases and financial reporting.
* Oversee project controls, integrated schedules, contracts, quality assurance, risk management and performance reporting across complex, interdependent workstreams.
* Ensure contractual compliance and effective administration of changes, claims, payments, procurement activities and project documentation.
* Develop and implement project management procedures, tools and controls that strengthen accountability, decision-making and delivery effectiveness.
* Advise on procurement, contracting and delivery strategies suited to complex electrical infrastructure, technology and utility interfaces

  

Stakeholder Relations, Governance & Communication

* Liaise with senior TTC leaders, consultants, contractors, government representatives, and external organizations to address requirements and advance project delivery.
* Represent TTC at project meetings, governance forums, public meetings, Board presentations, and industry events.
* Advise senior management and governance bodies on project performance, risks, opportunities, trade-offs, resource requirements, and key decisions.
* Build effective partnerships across engineering, operations, facilities, fleet, procurement, finance, legal, safety and other internal and external stakeholders.

**KEY SKILLS & EXPERTISE**
--------------------------

* Extensive knowledge of full-cycle project, program, and portfolio management principles and practices, with demonstrated ability to establish strategy and lead execution in complex capital environments.
* Demonstrated senior-level experience leading complex, multidisciplinary electrical infrastructure, electrification, charging infrastructure, utility, energy or comparable capital programs from strategy and planning through construction, energization, commissioning and operational readiness.
* Strong understanding of electrical infrastructure delivery, utility coordination, power capacity and energization requirements, and the technical and schedule dependencies associated with large-scale charging infrastructure deployment.
* Demonstrated ability to develop implementation strategies and translate long-term program objectives into executable infrastructure deployment plans, including sequencing, interfaces, dependencies, risk mitigation and resource requirements.
* Experience leading complex interfaces among utilities, engineering teams, contractors, technology suppliers, facility stakeholders and operations.
* Expertise in project controls, budgeting, procurement, contract administration, risk management, quality assurance, and performance reporting.
* Proven ability to lead and develop multidisciplinary teams while managing competing priorities and complex stakeholder environments.
* Strong analytical, negotiation, facilitation, communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills.
* Sound knowledge of applicable legislation, regulatory requirements, electrical and construction safety obligations, sustainability initiatives, and industry best practices.

**EDUCATION & PROFESSIONAL CREDENTIALS**
----------------------------------------

* Completion of a University Degree in Engineering or a related discipline, or a combination of education, training and experience deemed to be equivalent.
* A Portfolio Management Professional (PfMP), Program Management Professional (PgMP), or Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is preferred.
* Master of Business Administration (MBA) is preferred.
* Certification as a Professional Engineer or a similar professional designation in the Province of Ontario is considered an asset.

The TTC is committed to fostering a diverse workforce that is representative of the communities it serves at all levels of the organization and supports an inclusive environment where diverse employee and community perspectives and experiences bring value to the organization. Title: Project Manager, Artificial Intelligence - Regular Full-time - Programs, People & Leadership
Description:
Sunnybrook is seeking a Project Manager, Artificial Intelligence. Full-time and part-time arrangements will be considered. Artificial Intelligence is identified in Sunnybrook's Invent 2030 Strategic Plan as a key Digital Health and AI enabler. With established governance, a growing portfolio of AI applications, and a four-initiative enterprise roadmap, Sunnybrook is advancing the responsible adoption of AI across the organization. This role will build and manage the operational foundation for that work by supporting AI governance, establishing robust processes to oversee and sustain AI applications, and partnering with initiative leaders to measure and understand impact. The objective is clear: an AI portfolio defined not by the number of initiatives undertaken, but by demonstrable improvements in patient care, health system performance, and value.

  

We are looking for a health care project manager who brings structure to emerging, fast-moving work, is comfortable with AI and digital health concepts, and can translate between clinical, technical and executive audiences. This role will report to the Executive Vice President, Programs, People & Leadership (executive sponsor for AI), and will engage with the Senior Leadership Team, AI governance committees, Research, Program Chiefs, Operations Directors, Digital Health and Information Services, Privacy, Legal, Risk, Cybersecurity, Finance, initiative owners, vendors and external partners.

  

* AI Governance Support:
  + Coordinate the AI Executive Strategy Committee, AI Implementation Committee and Program AI Forum, including agendas, materials, decision and action logs, and follow-through
  + Work with Information Services to build on current processes and enhance the intake pathway for new AI proposals, so each moves smoothly through clinical, privacy, security, ethics, legal and procurement review to a clear decision
  + Maintain governance documentation (terms of reference, policies, standards, approval criteria and risk tiering) and keep it current as practice evolves
  + Prepare concise reporting for the Senior Leadership Team and the Digital Committee of the Board of Directors
  + Monitor the evolving regulatory, privacy and standards landscape for AI in health care and flag implications for Sunnybrook

* AI Portfolio Management:
  + Work with Information Services to enhance the existing enterprise inventory of AI applications in use and in development (Point, Enterprise and Scaled Solutions), providing greater information and clarity on owner, purpose, risk tier, status, cost and contract dates
  + Design and run a lifecycle process covering intake, pilot, evaluation, scale, ongoing monitoring and retirement
  + Lead a regular review cadence with owners to confirm each application remains safe, effective and valuable, and recommend whether to scale, fix or retire it
  + Track vendor contracts, renewals, product changes and embedded AI features in existing systems, in partnership with Procurement, Privacy and Cybersecurity

* Value and Performance Measurement:
  + Partner with initiative owners, before launch, to define the problem being solved, the baseline, and a small set of indicators across Sunnybrook’s three value domains: quality, experience for patients and staff, and cost
  + Develop a standard benefits realization framework and an enterprise AI value dashboard, working with Decision Support and Finance to validate data
  + Support post-implementation monitoring for performance drift, equity impacts and unintended consequences, with clinical leads and Quality & Patient Safety
  + Report results to governance committees with candour, including where initiatives are not delivering, so decisions are grounded in evidence

* Roadmap Initiative Support:
  + Provide project management support to the executive leads of the four enterprise initiatives: AI-Enabled Capacity Management, AI-Powered System Navigation, Targeted Clinical AI, and Finance Transformation around SAP
  + Maintain an integrated roadmap view of milestones, interdependencies (data, infrastructure, vendors, workforce) and risks, escalating appropriately
  + Produce consolidated roadmap status reporting for the Senior Leadership Team

* Change Management and Engagement:
  + Support initiative owners with adoption planning, including workflow redesign, training, communication and feedback loops
  + Support the executive leads accountable for AI literacy for all those that interact at Sunnybrook including Physicians, staff, volunteers and our broader patient community.
  + Maintain a central internal resource for staff and physicians: approved tools, how to bring forward an idea, and guidance on safe use
  + Coordinate Sunnybrook’s participation in external AI networks and partnerships, and capture lessons learned to share internally and across the system

**Qualifications/Skills**

  

* Master’s degree in Health Administration, Business Administration, Health Informatics or a related field, or equivalent combination of education, training and experience
* Minimum 3 years of project management experience in a hospital or health care setting; experience with digital health, clinical informatics or technology implementation is an asset
* Working knowledge of AI and machine learning concepts and their application in health care; hands-on comfort with generative AI tools (a technical or data science background is not required)
* Demonstrated experience developing performance measures, KPIs and benefits realization frameworks
* Experience supporting senior committees and governance processes
* Familiarity with health privacy (PHIPA), risk management and clinical technology governance
* Project management certification (e.g., PMP) and/or change management certification (e.g., Prosci) an asset
* High level of initiative and self-direction, with comfort in situations where the goal or the process to achieve it is unclear
* Ability to manage multiple, complex initiatives within tight timeframes
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to distill complexity for executive decision making

Title: Service Recovery Manager
Description:
Embark on a transformative journey as a Service Recovery Manager. At Barclays, our vision is clear –to redefine the future of banking and help craft innovative solutions. The service recovery function is critical to minimizing service disruption and protecting the experience of our customers, clients, and colleagues. In this role, you will play a pivotal role in supporting the response to major incidents, coordinating cross-functional teams, and driving rapid service restoration across multi-layered technology environments. This is a highly visible role that offers the opportunity to influence senior stakeholders, strengthen operational resilience, and make a measurable impact on the stability and reliability of critical banking services.
  
  
To be successful as a Service Recovery Manager, you should have:
  
  
  

* Demonstrated experience guiding the recovery of major incidents, coordinating technical teams, overseeing stakeholder communications, and driving service restoration within high-pressure, time-critical environments
* Extensive knowledge of IT Service, ITSM methodologies, including Incident, Problem, Change, Major Incident, and Service Continuity processes, ideally aligned to ITIL best practices
* Established ability to interpret sophisticated technical issues, assess business impact, enable timely agreements, and drive effective remediation and root cause resolution across infrastructure, application, network, and cloud services
* Considerable communication and stakeholder liaison skills, with the ability to provide clear, concise updates to senior executives, business stakeholders, support teams, and external vendors during service disruption events
* Experience leveraging operational monitoring, observability, automation, and collaboration tools to improve service resilience, reduce recovery times, and drive continuous improvement efforts

**Other Highly Valued Skills Include**

* Experience with observability, monitoring, and event coordination platforms such as Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Splunk, BigPanda, Netcool, Observe, and ServiceNow
* Knowledge of infrastructure, cloud, networks, middleware, databases, authentication services, and end-user technologies to support effective technical triage and sound judgment during service disruptions and major incidents
* Experience identifying opportunities for process optimization, automation, AI adoption, and operational efficiency improvements that reduce service disruption and recovery times
* Demonstrated ability to build good partnerships across Technology, Operations, Cyber, Business Support teams, and external vendors to improve service resilience and customer outcomes

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking, digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role is located in our Whippany, NJ office.
  
  
Minimum Salary: $130,000
  
  
Maximum Salary: $170,000
  
  
The minimum and maximum salary/rate information above include only base salary or base hourly rate. It does not include any other type of compensation or benefits that may be available.
  
  
Barclays employees are eligible for a suite of competitive and generous employee benefits, including medical, dental and vision coverage, 401(k), life insurance, and other paid leave for qualifying circumstances.
  
  
This position is eligible for an incentive award.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To mitigate the impact of unexpected incidents by identifying, responding and resolving disruptions that threaten the banks IT services, operations and technological infrastructure through effective decision making and successful resource delegation.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Development, implementation and management of major incident management programmes.
* Execution of responses to reported incidents from various channels including email, phone and monitoring systems, prioritised by its potential impact to the bank's IT systems, and provide regular status updates to affected stakeholders.
* Analysis of logs, system data and user reports to identify the root cause of incidents and determine the necessary course of action to resolve or follow escalation protocols to escalate incidents to the relevant team or individual for assistance.
* Execution of regular tests and simulations to test response procedures in the event of an incident.
* Documentation and analysis of past incident details, the steps to resolution and lessons learnt from each case to support the identification of recurring issues in the future, implement preventive measures to minimize future occurrence and to build a comprehensive knowledge bases of known issues.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. * Serve as the primary competitive intelligence advisor to the Calix sales organization.

* Partner with account teams on strategic opportunities and provide actionable recommendations that improve win rates.
* Identify competitive threats, market shifts, and emerging industry trends and communicate business implications to sales leadership.

* Automate timely content delivery to the field at the point of need, track usage and success metrics for impact and improvement.

Reporting to the VP, VAS Strategy & Operations, we are hiring a Director, Growth & Innovation Operations to accelerate the execution of strategic priorities across Altus Group’s Valuation Advisory Services (VAS) business. You will turn opportunities for commercial growth, operational improvement, and technology-enabled innovation into initiatives that deliver measurable results. Working across VAS, Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Enablement, and Operations, you will establish clear priorities, align teams, and lead initiatives from concept through implementation and adoption. This is a hands-on, player-coach role. You will directly lead a Senior Analyst and work with resources across the organization to strengthen accountability, improve visibility into performance, and build more effective, scalable ways of working. You will also personally own critical initiatives, develop plans, solve problems, and drive execution.

  

*This is a hybrid role based in Toronto, Ontario.*

  

**What’s in it for you**

  

*Strategic, measurable impact.* Altus Group brings together commercial real estate expertise, data, and technology to deliver value to clients. This is an opportunity to make strategy happen. You will play a meaningful role in advancing how VAS operates and grows, taking ownership of initiatives that improve commercial performance, introduce new capabilities, and create lasting operational improvements.

  

*Influence the direction the business takes.* You will work closely with senior leadership and collaborate across commercial, operational, and technology teams to solve challenges that extend beyond any one function. You will have the opportunity to bring structure to complex priorities, connect people around shared goals, and help leadership make informed decisions through clearer performance insights and accountability.

  

*The chance to lead, build, and deliver.* You will develop talent, draw on expertise across the organization, and remain close to the work that turns ideas into results. With a mandate spanning growth, operations, and innovation, you will take ownership and have the breadth and complexity to continue developing as a leader while building processes and capabilities that support the business over time.

  

*Help shape the future of technology-enabled services.* You will join a team actively exploring how AI, automation, and new technology can transform a people-driven professional services business. Rather than simply developing innovation strategies, you will help bring new capabilities into everyday operations, learn what works, and build scalable approaches that deliver meaningful business value.

**As our new Director, Growth & Innovation Operations, you will**

* **Turn strategic priorities into results.** You will translate complex business opportunities into clear objectives, actionable plans, and measurable outcomes. You will lead initiatives from early discovery through execution, addressing obstacles, managing competing priorities, and ensuring work progresses to completion.

* **Drive commercial and operational improvement.** You will identify opportunities to strengthen commercial performance, simplify processes, and improve efficiency across VAS. You will work with business leaders to develop practical solutions, establish clear ownership, and introduce repeatable ways of working that support sustainable growth.

* **Bring innovation into everyday operations.** You will partner with Product, Engineering, and business teams to evaluate and advance technology, automation, and AI-enabled opportunities. You will help translate business needs into practical requirements, coordinate implementation, and support adoption so new capabilities deliver value beyond launch.

* **Create visibility and accountability.** You will own weekly and monthly reporting across commercial performance, pipeline, bookings, revenue, operational initiatives, and innovation adoption. Working with existing data and reporting tools, you will connect information across the business, identify trends and risks, and translate insights into clear recommendations and actions for leadership. You will establish practical operating rhythms that strengthen accountability and support informed decisions.

* **Align teams and accelerate execution.** You will bring together stakeholders across functions, clarify responsibilities, and navigate dependencies that could slow progress. You will reconcile competing priorities, resolve roadblocks, and create the alignment required to move complex initiatives forward.

* **Lead and develop talent.** You will coach and support a Senior Analyst while coordinating expertise and resources across the organization. You will balance strategic direction with hands-on problem-solving, helping build the capabilities, discipline, and ownership needed to deliver consistently.

**You bring**

* **The track record of delivering business outcomes.** You have led complex, cross-functional initiatives in business operations, growth operations, transformation, product operations, consulting, or a related environment. You can point to meaningful improvements you have delivered, whether in commercial performance, operational efficiency, technology adoption, or how a business operates. Your experience extends beyond developing strategies or managing programs to owning implementation and results. Experience in commercial real estate, valuation, professional services, software, data, or another technology-enabled services business would be valuable.

* **The ability to create direction from ambiguity.** You have taken ownership of business challenges where the solution, scope, and path forward were not clearly defined. You know how to assess what matters, challenge assumptions, make sound trade-offs, and translate competing priorities into a practical course of action. You create enough structure to accelerate progress without introducing unnecessary complexity.

* **The experience navigating complex execution.** You have managed interconnected initiatives with multiple stakeholders, dependencies, and competing demands. You understand how to establish meaningful governance, identify risks early, and maintain momentum when priorities shift or decisions become difficult. You use performance measures and reporting to drive action and accountability, not simply to document activity.

* **The understanding of technology-enabled business change.** You have partnered with Product, Engineering, or technology teams to translate operational needs into solutions that work in practice. You understand how requirements, prioritization, testing, release readiness, and change adoption connect to successful delivery. You can assess the business value of new capabilities, including automation and AI, without needing to be the technical expert. Exposure to AI-enabled transformation, workflow automation, or technology adoption initiatives would also be an asset.

* **The judgment and influence to lead across functions.** You have worked closely with senior leaders and multidisciplinary teams, navigating differing perspectives and making recommendations that move decisions forward. You can connect commercial, operational, and technology considerations, explain trade-offs, and build commitment among people who do not report to you.

* **The leadership approach.** You have experience developing people and guiding teams while remaining personally accountable for complex work. You know when to delegate, when to coach, and when to step directly into a challenge. You are comfortable moving between executive discussions and detailed execution, and you measure leadership success by the outcomes your team delivers.

Title: Senior Project Manager (Experiential Production)
Description:
**THE·TEAM is proud to provide representation and marketing services to talent, brands and properties across 28 countries and more than 70 cities worldwide.**

  

**Shaped by our belief in the unifying power of sports, music and entertainment, THE·TEAM leads with intelligence, ideas and influence. For more information, please visit** **the.team** **.**

  

**Job Overview**

  

Our Experiential Operations, Production and Delivery team plays a pivotal role in the successful end-to-end delivery of our client accounts and events, owning client relationships, as well as supporting our integrated Experience team client roster. It’s a fast- paced, exciting, and diverse area of THE·TEAM, delivering projects across Canada and supporting clients throughout the US.

  

As part of an experienced and dynamic team, you’ll primarily focus on the successful management and operational delivery of large-scale signage and branding projects, while also supporting experiential builds, custom fabrication, integration of Experiential technology & tech, and complex installations depending on the needs of each project.

You’ll work across the full project lifecycle, from initial planning, feasibility and logistics planning, through the delivery of asset production, on-site installation, execution, dismantling, and return logistics.

  

Project planning and operational delivery are central to the role. You’ll lead internal and external stakeholder management, budgeting, creative assets, feasibility reviews, production planning, problem-solving and risk mitigation, and on-site crew and vendor management. This is also a hands-on role, requiring someone who is comfortable working alongside the team onsite and actively contributing to successful project delivery.

  

**This role is part of our Toronto team and is based at THE·TEAM’s full-service warehouse in Oakville, with an on-site requirement of five days per week.**

  

**What You’ll Do**

* Serve as the central senior day-to-day contact for internal teams and external vendors, with overall responsibility for successful project delivery.
* Collaborate with internal teams to develop project and signage programs, budgets, schedules, and project documentation, creating effective delivery strategies aligned with client-led operational deadlines.
* Lead the advance planning and management of complex production, logistical, and operational requirements, identifying risks and dependencies to ensure projects are set-up for successful delivery.
* Manage day-to-day project budgets in partnership with the Associate Director, Experiential Ops and Production, ensuring accurate pricing and cost control, while overseeing purchase orders, budget reconciliation, and the timely submission and tracking of vendor invoices.
* Ensure clear and timely communication between the Creative studio and Experience teams, coordinating creative development, feedback, approvals, and production-ready files for vendor delivery.
* Oversee the end-to-end production of creative assets, ensuring files are productionready, technically accurate, and meet all required speciﬁcations .
* Partner closely with printers, fabricators, and production vendors to review artwork and production requirements, troubleshoot technical issues, and ensure deliverables meet required quality standards.
* Lead production planning and workflows across internal teams and external vendors, managing production schedules, key milestones, dependencies, and deadlines to keep projects progressing efficiently and expectations proactively managed.
* Manage Production and Logistics teams, developing staffing plans and overseeing capacity planning, resource scheduling, detailed project preparation, and onsite resources to support successful delivery.
* Utilize internal inventory management systems to accurately categorize, track, and coordinate the safe storage of client assets.
* Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with external vendors while identifying and developing new vendor partnerships to support evolving project needs.
* Lead onsite installation and dismantling in partnership with vendors and internal teams, overseeing logistics, schedules, resources, and execution to deliver a seamless onsite experience.
Champion THE·TEAM's sustainability policy, identifying opportunities to align our sustainability goals with those of our clients through environmentally responsible materials, processes, and delivery strategies.  

  

**What We’re Looking For:**

* 5-7+ years’ experience in operations and production with experiential led sports and entertainment industries
* Proven project management experience across operational planning and delivery, with the ability to manage complex projects against challenging timelines
* Clear and effective communicator, demonstrated ability to work confidently across internal teams, clients, vendors, and external stakeholders.
* Strong relationship management, inﬂuencing, and negotiation skills, with the diplomacy to navigate competing priorities and stakeholder needs.
* Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, delegate effectively, and maintain clear project systems, processes, and documentation.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to assess risk, think creatively, and resolve issues quickly and effectively.
* Conﬁdence in leading ﬁnancials across projects and client accounts, including budget management, forecasting, pricing, and cost control.
* Proven ability to lead and motivate cross-functional teams, build accountability, and foster a positive and collaborative working environment.
* Flexible and adaptable, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment and support the wider business as priorities evolve.
* Proactive and solutions-oriented, with the initiative to develop ideas, take ownership, and carry projects through from concept to successful completion.
* Willing and able to work in a hands-on onsite environment and actively contribute alongside the team, including extended periods of standing and walking, as well as lifting, carrying, moving, and positioning event materials and equipment.
Due to the nature of event and project delivery, flexibility in working hours is required. This may occasionally include early mornings, evenings, weekends, and extended hours to support onsite installation, event delivery, and dismantling.  

  
  

*Base salary range: $70,000- $80,000 CAD.*

Title: Manager, Product Strategy & Operations
Description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

**About the Role**
------------------

  
  

At eBay, we offer an outstanding chance to lead and innovate within our Services & Experience portfolio, spanning ads, shipping, payments, monetization, compliance, and risk. As the Manager, Product Strategy & Operations, you will change our processes by using AI tools to automate and improve operations. You will report to the Director of Product Strategy and Operations and collaborate with product leads, engineering, Finance, and program and product operations teams to deliver seamless execution and pivotal initiatives.

  
  

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

  
  

Manage product strategy and operations for your designated area (about 45%)

  
  

* Coordinate the operating cycle for one or two product areas, ensuring cadence, cross-team dependencies, launch readiness, and reporting are strictly managed.
* Monitor regulatory, risk, and partner requirements, identifying constraints, owners, and deadlines.
* Conduct weekly operating reviews and monthly business reviews, ensuring each concludes with clear decisions and ownership.
* Proactively advance any commitments at risk, providing data and viable options.
  

  

Automate your own work (at least 30%, protected)

  
  

* Develop agents and workflows that gather status updates, flag at-risk commitments, and generate recurring reports.
* Automate repetitive tasks to improve efficiency and share successful methods with colleagues.
* Document guidelines in a playbook to ensure widespread adoption.
* Track and report hours saved and error rates per workflow.
  

  

Support planning and the portfolio (about 15%)

  
  

* Prepare priority intake, goal frameworks, and theme-level funding requests for your area's planning cycle.
* Coordinate your area's commitments with the revenue plan together with Finance.
  

  

Measure outcomes (about 10%)

  
  

* Define success criteria at launch and perform post-launch assessments with product leads.
* Adhere to shared reporting standards, proposing changes where necessary.
  

  

**What You Will Bring**
-----------------------

  
  

* 4 to 7 years of experience in product operations, program management, business operations, strategy, or a technical role within a product or technology organization.
* Proven track record in managing cross-team delivery, including collaboration with external partners or regulated launches.
* Demonstrated ability to develop tools or agents that provide significant time savings.
* Proficient in LLM APIs, SQL or Python, and workflow tools.
* Skilled in communicating with senior leaders about potential risks and providing data-driven solutions.
* Meticulous in reviewing model outputs to ensure accuracy.
* Strong writing skills, presenting conclusions upfront.
  

  

**How We Will Measure Success**
-------------------------------

  
  

* Percentage of projects in your area completed within the scheduled timeframe.
* Decrease in days from approved idea to funded, staffed start in your area.
* Percentage of outcome assessments completed for launches within your region.
* Net hours delivered back to program and product teams each quarter.
* Adoption rate of the tools you develop among colleagues.

C$102,800 - C$137,200

This role will have primary accountability for ensuring that all construction vendors complete required restoration work in a timely, safe, compliant, and high-quality manner across all build areas. The Restoration Manager will act as the primary point of contact for restoration activities, coordinating multiple vendors, tracking outstanding deficiencies, managing priorities, and working closely with Construction, Engineering, Municipal Relations, Quality, and other internal teams to ensure restoration requirements are completed and accepted. The successful candidate will be highly organized, field-oriented, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple vendors and competing priorities across a large geographic footprint.

**Responsibilities & Key Duties:**

Restoration Management

* Own the end-to-end restoration process for all FTTH construction areas.
* Develop and maintain a comprehensive inventory of outstanding restoration requirements by area, vendor, project, and municipality.
* Establish restoration priorities and drive vendors to complete work within required timelines.
* Ensure all restoration activities are completed in accordance with municipal standards, approved construction requirements, permits, and TelMAX standards.
* Monitor restoration progress from initial construction through final completion and municipal acceptance.
* Identify and escalate restoration risks, delays, deficiencies, and potential compliance issues.

Vendor Management

* Act as the primary point of contact for vendors responsible for restoration activities.
* Establish clear expectations, schedules, deliverables, and completion dates with each vendor.
* Hold vendors accountable for outstanding restoration work and deficiencies.
* Conduct regular vendor reviews and follow up on overdue or incomplete work.
* Coordinate additional resources or corrective action where vendors are unable to meet required timelines.
* Track vendor performance and identify recurring quality or performance issues.
* Support vendor performance management, including escalation of persistent non-performance to Construction leadership.

Field Coordination & Quality

* Conduct regular field inspections to verify that restoration work has been completed properly.
* Validate that restoration meets municipal, property, and TelMAX requirements.
* Coordinate the correction of deficient restoration work with vendors.
* Work with municipalities and inspectors to address restoration-related concerns and deficiencies.
* Ensure temporary restoration is transitioned to permanent restoration where required.
* Confirm that completed restoration is properly documented and ready for municipal inspection or acceptance.

Project Tracking & Reporting

* Maintain an accurate restoration dashboard showing:
  + Outstanding restoration items
  + Vendor assignments
  + Target completion dates
  + Aging of outstanding items
  + Deficiencies and rework
  + Municipal inspection status
  + Completed/closed restoration
* Provide regular reporting to Construction leadership on restoration progress, risks, and vendor performance.
* Establish KPIs and reporting mechanisms to measure restoration performance across the FTTH program.
* Identify trends and recurring issues and recommend process improvements.

Municipal & Stakeholder Coordination

* Work closely with Municipal Relations and Construction teams to understand municipal restoration requirements and deadlines.
* Support responses to municipal restoration complaints, deficiencies, and escalations.
* Coordinate vendor responses to municipal requirements and inspection findings.
* Help ensure restoration commitments made to municipalities are tracked and delivered.
* Support the resolution of property-owner restoration concerns where required.

Financial Management

* Monitor restoration costs and vendor spend against approved budgets.
* Identify potential cost overruns, unauthorized work, and additional restoration costs.
* Review vendor restoration claims and supporting documentation as required.
* Escalate material cost variances and financial risks to Construction leadership.
* Support the recovery of costs from vendors where restoration deficiencies or rework are attributable to vendor performance.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Accountable for improving and maintaining performance against key restoration metrics, including:

* Percentage of restoration completed within required timelines
* Aging of outstanding restoration items
* Number of overdue restoration items
* Municipal restoration deficiencies
* Restoration rework rate
* Vendor restoration performance
* Time from construction completion to final restoration
* Time from deficiency identification to correction
* Number of open municipal complaints related to restoration
* Restoration cost per home/premise
* Percentage of builds achieving municipal closeout/acceptance

**What You Bring:**

* **Accountability:** Takes ownership of restoration outcomes and drives issues to closure.
* **Vendor Management:** Holds vendors accountable while maintaining productive working relationships.
* **Execution:** Focuses on completing work and closing outstanding items rather than simply tracking them.
* **Organization:** Maintains accurate records, priorities, schedules, and follow-ups across a large program.
* **Problem Solving:** Quickly identifies root causes and develops practical solutions to restoration challenges.
* **Communication:** Clearly communicates expectations, deadlines, deficiencies, and escalations.
* **Attention to Detail:** Ensures restoration meets municipal and telMAX standards.
* **Leadership:** Influences vendors and internal stakeholders to achieve results without necessarily having direct authority over them.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Identifies opportunities to improve restoration processes, vendor performance, and overall construction closeout.

**Experience:**

* 5+ years of experience in construction, restoration, civil construction, telecommunications, utilities, or a related field.
* Experience managing construction or restoration vendors.
* Experience working with municipalities, inspectors, or right-of-way requirements is strongly preferred.
* Experience in FTTH, telecommunications, utility construction, or civil construction is an asset.
* Strong understanding of construction restoration practices, including asphalt, concrete, landscaping, sod, topsoil, curbs, sidewalks, and related municipal infrastructure.
* Strong project and vendor management skills.
* Excellent organizational and time-management abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, vendors, and geographic areas simultaneously.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.
* Strong analytical and reporting capabilities.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and construction/project management systems.
* Valid driver's licence and ability to travel regularly to construction sites.

Success in this role will be measured by the Restoration Manager's ability to take ownership of the restoration backlog, establish clear accountability with vendors, reduce aging and outstanding deficiencies, and consistently drive restoration through to final completion and municipal acceptance.

We hold ourselves to the highest standards, delivering exceptional results through dedication, accountability, and continuous improvement. Our commitment to excellence drives us to push boundaries, take ownership, and always follow through.

We move fast, adapt with courage, and work together to solve challenges. Through empowerment and open communication, we foster a culture where bold ideas thrive. We leverage our collective strengths, achieve shared success and deliver exceptional results for our customers and teams.

Title: Director of Service Desk Support

Onsite in Chandler, AZ five days per week, with periodic travel to other company locations. Occasional evening or weekend work may be required for maintenance and site projects.

Description:

**Description**
**Job Summary:**
The Director, Global End User Compute (EUC) is responsible for the strategy, architecture, delivery, security, and operational performance of end-user technology services across the global enterprise. Reporting within the CISO organization, this role provides leadership for the technologies and services that enable employees to securely and effectively access corporate systems, applications, collaboration platforms, and workplace technology.
  
  
The Director will lead a global End User Compute organization responsible for desktop and endpoint support, laptops and workstations, mobile devices, Microsoft Intune and endpoint management, software distribution, device lifecycle management, audiovisual and conference room technologies, executive technology support, and related employee-facing IT services.
  
  
This role requires a strong combination of technical depth, operational leadership, cybersecurity awareness, and people management. The Director will establish global standards while ensuring EUC services remain responsive to regional business requirements and deliver a consistent, secure, and high-quality employee experience.
  
  
Operating in a fast-paced global technology environment, the Director will partner closely with Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Network, Service Desk, Identity and Access Management, Enterprise Applications, Facilities, Human Resources, and business leaders to modernize the digital workplace and improve the overall end-user technology experience.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Global End User Compute Strategy & Leadership**

* Develop and execute the global End User Compute strategy, roadmap, operating model, and technology standards aligned with business, IT, and cybersecurity objectives.
* Provide global leadership for employee-facing technology services across corporate offices, remote workers, engineering environments, and other business locations.
* Establish consistent EUC standards, processes, service levels, performance metrics, and support models across geographic regions.
* Lead, develop, and mentor a geographically distributed team of managers, engineers, administrators, and support professionals.
* Balance operational stability with modernization, automation, security, and continuous improvement.
* Develop annual operating plans, budgets, resource requirements, technology roadmaps, and investment recommendations for EUC services.
* Establish measurable KPIs covering employee experience, device health, incident resolution, service availability, security compliance, and operational efficiency.

**Desktop & Endpoint Support**

* Own the global desktop and endpoint support model for Windows and macOS laptops, desktops, workstations, peripherals, and related employee technology.
* Establish standardized processes for device provisioning, configuration, deployment, support, replacement, refresh, and retirement.
* Drive improvements in first-contact resolution, mean time to resolution, endpoint reliability, and employee satisfaction.
* Define tiered escalation processes between Service Desk, desktop support, engineering, infrastructure, application, and cybersecurity teams.
* Establish specialized support models for executives, critical business functions, engineering teams, and other high-priority users where appropriate.
* Ensure endpoint support capabilities effectively support office-based, hybrid, and remote employees globally.

**Endpoint Engineering & Microsoft Intune**

* Provide technical and operational leadership for Microsoft Intune and modern endpoint management across the enterprise.
* Own endpoint configuration standards, compliance policies, security baselines, application deployment, device enrollment, configuration profiles, and lifecycle management.
* Partner with Cybersecurity to implement and maintain endpoint security controls, hardening standards, encryption, endpoint detection and response, vulnerability remediation, and compliance requirements.
* Drive adoption of zero-touch and automated provisioning technologies, including Windows Autopilot and modern device enrollment capabilities.
* Oversee operating system deployment, patching, application packaging, software distribution, configuration management, and endpoint remediation.
* Develop an endpoint engineering roadmap that reduces manual administration and increases automation, self-service, security, and consistency.
* Maintain accurate endpoint inventory, ownership, configuration, compliance, and lifecycle

**Mobile Device Management**

* Own the global strategy and operational management of corporate and authorized personal mobile devices.
* Establish standards for iOS, Android, smartphones, tablets, and other mobile endpoints.
* Manage mobile device enrollment, application deployment, configuration, security policies, compliance, remote wipe, and device lifecycle through Intune and related platforms.
* Partner with Procurement and telecommunications providers on mobile device purchasing, carrier management, international services, and cost optimization.
* Define and maintain appropriate corporate-owned, BYOD, and mobile application management policies.
* Ensure mobile access to corporate information meets cybersecurity, privacy, legal, and regulatory requirements.

**Audiovisual & Conference Room Technology**

* Own the global standards and operational support model for conference rooms, meeting spaces, collaboration rooms, executive meeting rooms, and audiovisual technologies.
* Establish standards for Microsoft Teams Rooms and other approved conferencing and collaboration platforms.
* Oversee conference room displays, cameras, microphones, speakers, control systems, room scheduling technologies, and related infrastructure.
* Partner with Facilities and Network teams on new office construction, office expansions, relocations, and conference room deployments.
* Establish proactive monitoring and maintenance capabilities to identify and remediate conference room technology issues before they impact meetings.
* Maintain standardized room designs and technology configurations to provide a consistent employee experience across global offices.
* Develop lifecycle and refresh strategies for audiovisual and collaboration technologies.

**Employee Digital Experience**

* Champion the overall digital employee experience, ensuring technology is reliable, intuitive, secure, and easy to access.
* Establish mechanisms to measure employee satisfaction and identify recurring technology friction points.
* Use endpoint analytics, service management data, incident trends, employee feedback, and device telemetry to proactively improve EUC services.
* Expand employee self-service and automated remediation capabilities to reduce support dependency and improve resolution times.
* Identify opportunities to use automation, AI, analytics, and emerging technologies to improve support delivery and employee productivity.

**Security, Risk & Compliance**

* Partner closely with the CISO organization to ensure endpoint technologies comply with enterprise cybersecurity policies and standards.
* Ensure endpoints meet requirements for encryption, endpoint protection, patching, vulnerability management, privileged access, data protection, device compliance, and secure configuration.
* Support cybersecurity incident response activities involving employee endpoints and mobile devices.
* Maintain appropriate logging, asset records, configuration documentation, and evidence required for internal and external audits.
* Partner with Governance, Risk, and Compliance teams to remediate endpoint-related findings and control deficiencies.
* Ensure lost, stolen, compromised, or non-compliant devices can be quickly identified, contained, disabled, or remotely wiped.
* Participate in technology risk assessments and establish remediation plans for identified EUC risks.

**Device Lifecycle & Asset Management**

* Establish global standards for end-user hardware selection, procurement, deployment, refresh, recovery, and secure disposal.
* Partner with Procurement and Finance to optimize hardware purchasing, warranty management, licensing, inventory, and lifecycle costs.
* Maintain accurate inventories of laptops, desktops, mobile devices, peripherals, and other EUC assets.
* Develop global device refresh standards based on age, performance, security requirements, business need, and total cost of ownership.
* Ensure secure data removal and environmentally responsible disposal of retired technology.
* Support employee onboarding, transfers, relocations, leaves, and offboarding through standardized technology lifecycle processes.

**Operational Management & Service Delivery**

* Establish and manage SLAs, OLAs, KPIs, service dashboards, and operational reviews for EUC services.
* Monitor incident volumes, recurring problems, aging tickets, device health, endpoint compliance, conference room availability, and employee satisfaction.
* Lead root-cause analysis and corrective action for significant or recurring end-user technology incidents.
* Participate in major incident management when endpoint or workplace technologies materially affect business operations.
* Establish capacity, continuity, and recovery plans for critical EUC technologies and services.
* Maintain current technical documentation, standards, operating procedures, support playbooks, and escalation processes.
* Drive a culture of ownership, urgency, accountability, customer service, and continuous improvement.

**Vendor, Financial & Technology Management**

* Manage strategic relationships with hardware manufacturers, software providers, mobile carriers, audiovisual vendors, managed service providers, and other EUC partners.
* Participate in contract negotiations, licensing reviews, renewals, technology evaluations, and vendor performance reviews.
* Develop and manage EUC operating and capital budgets.
* Identify opportunities to consolidate technologies, eliminate redundant tools, reduce costs, and improve operational efficiency.
* Evaluate emerging endpoint, workplace, collaboration, automation, and employee experience technologies and make recommendations for adoption.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting a large global technology, semiconductor, manufacturing, or engineering organization.
* Experience operating within or closely aligned to a CISO or cybersecurity organization.
* Experience with Microsoft security and management technologies including Intune, Entra ID, Defender, Microsoft 365, and related endpoint security capabilities.
* Experience implementing modern workplace, zero-touch deployment, digital employee experience, and endpoint automation strategies.
* Familiarity with ITIL or other formal IT service management frameworks.
* Experience with ServiceNow or comparable enterprise IT service management and asset management platforms.
* Relevant Microsoft, ITIL, security, or technology management certifications are preferred.

**Requirements**

* Demonstrated experience leading End User Compute, Workplace Technology, Desktop Engineering, Endpoint Engineering, or similar enterprise functions.
* Strong technical knowledge of Microsoft Intune, endpoint management, Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, and modern endpoint provisioning.
* Experience with Windows Autopilot, application packaging and deployment, patch management, endpoint configuration, device compliance, and software distribution.
* Strong understanding of endpoint security technologies and practices, including EDR, encryption, vulnerability management, hardening, privileged access, and zero-trust principles.
* Experience managing enterprise mobile device and mobile application management environments.
* Experience supporting and standardizing Microsoft Teams Rooms, audiovisual systems, conference room technologies, and enterprise collaboration platforms.
* Strong understanding of IT service management principles, incident management, problem management, change management, asset management, and service-level management.
* Experience managing large-scale hardware refreshes, technology migrations, office deployments, or global endpoint transformation initiatives.
* Demonstrated ability to manage technology vendors, contracts, budgets, licensing, and service providers.
* Strong analytical capabilities with experience using operational metrics and technology data to identify trends and drive improvements.
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts effectively to both technical teams and senior business executives.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through organizational and technology change in a fast-paced, global enterprise environment.
* Strong leadership, organizational, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Education And Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* 10+ years of progressive IT experience, including significant experience supporting enterprise end-user computing environments.
* 7+ years of leadership experience managing technical teams, preferably across multiple geographic regions.

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on service quality, workflow optimization, productivity, and customer experience.
* Leverage operational data, performance metrics, and quality indicators to identify opportunities and drive strategic improvements.

The Manager, Transit Operations is responsible for overseeing day-to-day operations and administrative duties for the Operations department. The Manager will ensure transit services, operations and programs are run safely, efficiently and, in a financially responsible manner.

* Ensure compliance with the Occupational Health and Safety Act, including joint health and safety committee participation and workplace violence and harassment obligations.
* Ensure operators complete and maintain required training, including AODA and Ontario Human Rights Code training, per the Burlington Transit Accessibility Plan.
